Controversy has erupted over the portrayal of a character resembling mafia don Atiq Ahmed, shown as having links with Pakistan’s intelligence agency ISI and a terrorist organisation. 4. Govt tells SC in Sabarimala case, ‘Courts should not interfere in religious matters’ The Supreme Court began hearing whether women can enter Kerala’s Sabarimala temple. The government argued that barring women aged 10–50 respects tradition. 5. Dubai-based Akib denies links to terror plot: Akib says he won’t betray the country The Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorism Squad has arrested four suspected terrorists accused of plotting attacks across several cities, including Lucknow. 6. Kanpur racket trapped youths via gaming apps: Doctors cited US-UK research claims longer life with one kidney A disturbing kidney transplant racket in Kanpur has come to light, where young men were trapped through gaming apps and coerced into donating their kidneys. 7. Assam police raid Pawan Khera's home over claim that Himanta's wife holds 3 passports Assam Police raided the residence of Congress leader Pawan Khera in Delhi on Tuesday morning. Two days ago, Pawan had accused Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma's wife of possessing three passports. 8. MLA’s son occupies the superintendent’s seat: Visits the government hospital in Rampur A 22-year-old man, Umair Ansari, son of an Apna Dal (S) MLA, inspected a government hospital in Rampur and questioned doctors and staff. He visited the Community Health Centre in Swar on Saturday morning around 11 AM. 9. Drivers will not feel drowsy on the Ganga Expressway: Rest facilities available every 75 km Uttar Pradesh’s 594 km-long Ganga Expressway is nearing completion, with finishing work currently underway. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to inaugurate it soon. 10. Air India raises fuel surcharge by up to ₹899 Tata Group-owned Air India has hiked fuel surcharge once again in the wake of rising jet fuel prices due to crude oil supply disruptions owing to the West Asia conflict. The airline has this time increased the surcharge from ₹299 to ₹899.

stories.title: Woman jumps from 16th floor in Ghaziabad:Preparing for UP Police, family alleges someone pushed her
stories.summary: In Ghaziabad, on Tuesday morning, around 6:10 AM, a young woman committed suicide by jumping from the 16th floor. At the time of the incident, the young woman was in a semi-naked state. As soon as she fell, there was a commotion in the society, and people from the vicinity gathered at the spot. The young woman, Sandhya (18), was preparing for UP Police recruitment. Her father works as a clothes presser in the same society, due to which she used to frequent the place. Her family members alleged that someone pushed Sandhya from the 16th floor. Upon receiving the information, the police reached the spot, took the body into custody, and sent it for post-mortem. Police are scrutinizing the CCTV camera footage installed in the society. The incident occurred at Jaipuria Sunrise Green Society, located in the Indirapuram police station area. She went out for a run from home, her body was found in the society Sandhya was the daughter of Sukhdev Kanojia, a resident of Hardoi district. Sukhdev has been living with his family in Kanawani village, Ghaziabad, for the past 30 years. He works as an ironer of clothes in Jaipuria Sunrise Green Society. He has three daughters. Sandhya used to go for a run every morning. On Tuesday morning too, she left home for a run. During this, she reached the society and jumped from the C block of the 16th floor of the building in a semi-naked state. At that time, she was not wearing full clothes. According to the police, the girl is seen going alone in the lift in the society's CCTV footage. She was also seen exiting the lift alone from the lift on the 16th floor. An investigation into the matter has been started. However, the reason for the incident is not yet clear. Father said - My daughter cannot jump The deceased's father, Sukhdev Kanojia, said - I cannot believe that my daughter committed suicide. I suspect a conspiracy in this whole matter. Someone must have called her up with the lift and then deliberately pushed her. He has demanded an impartial investigation from the police. ACP Indirapuram Abhishek Srivastava said - Around 6:30 AM, police received information that the body of a young woman was found near C Tower of Jaipuriya Sunrise Green Society. Upon receiving the information, police reached the spot, took the body into custody, and sent it for post-mortem. Further action is being taken based on the complaint filed by the family members. Footage from nearby CCTV cameras is also being scrutinized.

stories.title: Storm in Mathura blows away tent for CM's event:Gate collapses on auto in Agra, trees and poles uprooted in Hathras
stories.summary: The spell of rain and strong winds has not stopped in Uttar Pradesh despite the heat. In Mathura, strong winds and rain hit on Tuesday afternoon, blowing away the tent set up for the Sant Malook Das birth anniversary programme. The administration quickly restored the arrangements. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat had attended the event earlier in the morning. Heavy rain also began around 3 pm in Ghaziabad and Noida. In Badaun, strong winds were followed by heavy rainfall in the afternoon. Earlier in the day, light showers were seen at intervals in Lucknow and Meerut. The weather department has issued an alert for thunderstorms, rain and hail in 34 districts today. In some areas, winds may reach speeds of up to 60 kmph. The weather is expected to remain unsettled for the next two days, until 9 April. Due to rain and strong winds, the average temperature across the state has dropped by 4 to 5°C. In the past four days, rain has been recorded in 43 districts including Varanasi and Kanpur. Hailstorms were reported in 10 cities, including Mathura, Sambhal and Jalaun. So far, 15 people have died due to storms and lightning. Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Singh said- A new Western Disturbance is becoming active from today. There will be rain with storms across the entire state. Hail will also fall. Wind speed will reach up to 60 km. Temperature will drop by 3 to 5 degrees. Its maximum impact will be seen in Western UP tomorrow, i.e., April 8th. The weather will remain like this until April 9th. How will the weather be for the next 2 days? See today's weather pictures - How many deaths in which districts due to storm-rain, know In the last 4 days, 4 people died in Kanpur due to storm-rain and lightning. Additionally, 3 people died in Sitapur, and 2 each in Varanasi, Chitrakoot, Siddharthnagar, and Lalitpur. Damage to wheat-mustard crops due to unseasonal rain Yogi said - negligence will not be tolerated, officers should remain alert CM Yogi has said that any kind of negligence in the damage being caused to farmers due to rain will not be tolerated. He has sought damage reports from all DMs. He said - all officials should remain on alert mode. Ensure that the impact of the disaster on farmers is minimized. If there is any loss of life, property, or livestock, or if anyone is injured, compensation should be provided within 24 hours.

stories.title: MLA’s son occupies superintendent’s seat:Visits government hospital in Rampur; reprimands doctors during inspection
stories.summary: A 22-year-old man, Umair Ansari, son of an Apna Dal (S) MLA, inspected a government hospital in Rampur and questioned doctors and staff. He visited the Community Health Centre (CHC) in Swar on Saturday morning around 11 AM. During the visit, he entered the emergency ward, spoke to patients and asked doctors about treatment. He later went to the Superintendent’s office, sat on the official chair, checked documents and scolded doctors. Four policemen, including a sub-inspector and three constables, were seen providing him security without any official protocol. The hospital staff and the superintendent appeared helpless during the visit, as the MLA’s son continued to show authority for nearly an hour. The video of the incident surfaced on Monday. Chief Medical Officer Deepa Singh has ordered an inquiry and asked for a report within 7 days. The Superintendent of Police has also ordered an inquiry into the policemen. Shafiq Ahmed Ansari is the MLA from Suar seat. Umair Ansari's mother, Reshma Parveen, is the Chairperson of Suar Nagar Palika. When MLA father Shafiq Ansari was asked about his son's CHC inspection, he said- I was out of the area. I received complaints about mismanagement at the CHC. That's why I personally sent my son to check the arrangements. His going for inspection is not wrong in any way. See pictures related to the MLA's son's inspection The MLA's son was seen sitting on the Superintendent's chair in CHC. Nearby, the Superintendent stood showing documents. Now, the complete matter in sequence MLA's son Umair reached Swar CHC for inspection at 11 AM on Saturday. Along with Umair, there were 4 policemen and two supporters. It is visible in the video that he first reached the emergency ward and inquired about the patients' condition. He checked the employees' attendance registers. He observed the medicine distribution system. He also checked the functioning of the lab and the condition of the machines. After this, Umair reached the CHC Superintendent's office. As soon as he saw the MLA's son, CHC In-charge Dr. Rajiv Chandel left his chair and stood up. Umair sat on his chair. He started checking documents there. During this, Dr. Rajiv stood beside him and was seen showing him documents. Umair questioned the CHC In-charge and doctors. He warned the CHC Superintendent that patients should not be prescribed outside medicines. They should not be sent outside for tests. If this is found to be the case, action will be taken. CMO said - MLA's son has no right to investigate CMO Dr. Deepa Singh said - The MLA's son or any family member has no right to inspect a government institution. Sitting on an officer's chair and giving instructions is a violation of protocol. A team has been constituted under the chairmanship of ACMO Santosh Kumar to investigate the matter. It is being investigated which protocols have been violated. The team has been asked to submit the report within 7 days. Action will be taken based on the report. SP Somendra Meena said- An investigation will be conducted into what order or protocol policemen were present with the MLA's son. If a violation of rules is found, action will be taken.Umair reprimanded the doctors and staff. Warned of action.storage.

stories.title: Chirag Paswan to contest polls independently in UP:LJP (R) to contest on all 403 seats, party says 'Alliance with BJP is only at Centre'
stories.summary: Chirag Paswan’s party, Lok Janshakti Party (Ramvilas), which has established a strong foothold in Bihar politics, is now set to enter the electoral arena of Uttar Pradesh. The party has announced that it will contest all 403 seats in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. This move is being seen as an effort to strengthen its base among Dalit and youth voters in the state. It has also triggered political debate over which parties may face pressure following Chirag’s entry into UP politics. No state alliance despite NDA ties Rajeev Paswan, the party’s East UP State President, clarified that while the party is aligned with the BJP at the Centre, there is no alliance in Uttar Pradesh. He said the party will contest the elections independently with the slogans ‘UP First’ and ‘People of UP first’. At present, Chirag Paswan is a Union Minister in the National Democratic Alliance government led by Narendra Modi. However, his focus in Uttar Pradesh is expected to be on the Dalit vote bank. A significant portion of this vote base is traditionally held by the Bahujan Samaj Party, while Chandrashekhar Azad of the Azad Samaj Party is also actively working to consolidate it. Expansion after Bihar success Following a 100% strike rate in the Lok Sabha elections and a strong performance in the Bihar Assembly elections, Chirag Paswan is now looking to expand the party’s footprint nationally. Party sources suggest that he believes his father, Ram Vilas Paswan, had a considerable support base in Uttar Pradesh. The current strategy aims to revive that base and position the party as a third political alternative in the state. Split within the party after Ram Vilas Paswan’s death After the death of Ram Vilas Paswan, the party witnessed a major split on 14 June 2021. Five MPs—Pashupati Kumar Paras, Choudhary Mehboob Ali Kaiser, Veena Devi, Chandan Singh, and Prince Raj, removed Chirag Paswan from all party posts. Pashupati Kumar Paras, Chirag’s uncle, was chosen as their leader. This development came months after the 2020 Bihar Assembly elections and the passing of Ram Vilas Paswan. Setback: Loss of power and position On 7 July 2021, Pashupati Paras became a Union Minister, further sidelining Chirag from power at both the Centre and the state level. Chirag also had to vacate the government bungalow allotted in his father’s name. At that stage, his political career appeared to be at a standstill. Analysts observed that the internal family conflict had significantly weakened his position, with his uncle seemingly taking control of Ram Vilas Paswan’s political legacy. Political struggle and rebuilding phase Despite these setbacks, Chirag Paswan did not withdraw from politics. He continued his political struggle, including a phase of rebellion against Nitish Kumar in Bihar. Observers note that Chirag remained politically active and positioned himself as a loyal supporter of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, often describing himself as his ‘Hanuman’. His persistence paid off when he secured victory from the Hajipur seat, reaffirming his political relevance. Resurgence in the 2024 Lok Sabha Elections Ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, the rivalry between Chirag and his uncle resurfaced, particularly over the Hajipur seat. Pashupati Paras was reluctant to уступ the constituency, leading to prolonged negotiations within the NDA. Senior BJP leaders, including JP Nadda, were involved in discussions, but the deadlock persisted for some time. Eventually, Chirag strengthened his position within the alliance and secured his political ground. This phase marked a turning point, with Chirag emerging as a key player within the NDA. Strong showing in Bihar Assembly Polls In the 2025 Bihar Assembly elections, Lok Janshakti Party (Ramvilas) delivered an impressive performance as part of the NDA alliance. The party contested around 28–29 seats and won 19 of them, signalling a significant political comeback. Delighted by this success, Chirag Paswan is now aiming to replicate his gains in Uttar Pradesh and establish his party as a formidable force beyond Bihar.

stories.title: Speeding car collides with Budh Vihar Gate in Gorakhpur:Bullet also hit, vehicle loses rear wheel, it flies and falls 50 metres away
stories.summary: In the Ramgarh Taal police station area of Gorakhpur, a speeding car met with an accident on Monday night. This incident occurred around 10 PM at the main gate of Buddha Vihar located in Paddleganj. According to eyewitnesses, a Volkswagen Polo car coming from the direction of Nauka Vihar was at high speed. After suddenly losing control, the car crashed straight into the gate of Buddha Vihar. The impact was so severe that the rear wheels of the car detached and flew approximately 50 meters away. During the accident, a Bullet bike that was moving in front of the car also came under its impact. The people riding on the bike were seriously injured. After the incident, chaos ensued at the spot and people from nearby gathered. Some people helped the injured, while some were seen making videos and taking photos. After the accident, the people in the car abandoned the vehicle and fled from the spot. Upon receiving information, Padaleganj outpost police reached the spot and immediately sent the injured to the district hospital. According to police, the condition of all the injured is being reported as stable at present. Police have taken the car into custody and started investigating the case, and a search is underway for the absconding accused. Police say that the accused will be caught soon and the actual causes of the incident are being investigated.

stories.title: Students protest outside VC residence in BHU:Warden locks Bhagwan Das Hostel room, security personnel arrive with faces covered
stories.summary: Students are protesting outside the Vice-Chancellor’s residence at Kashi Hindu University. The issue relates to Bhagwan Das Hostel. It is reported that an expelled student had come to the hostel for a meal. During this time, the warden arrived and locked Room No. 90 of the student who was staying with him. Students have alleged that when the other student had done nothing wrong, why was he evicted and his room locked? Dispute over room locking A student stated that a student named Shani had been expelled from his room after being found guilty in a dispute. However, as two students share one room, the warden also removed the other boy living there and locked the room. When he tried to call, there was no response. Following this, students gathered outside the Vice-Chancellor’s residence, whom they consider their guardian. Meanwhile, members of the Proctorial Board arrived with their faces covered. Demand for action against warden Agitated students have staged a protest outside the VC’s residence, demanding action against the warden. In view of the protest, a large police presence along with the Proctorial Board team has been deployed. Authorities are currently attempting to calm the situation through dialogue with the students.

stories.title: Dubai-based Akib denies links to terror plot:Akib says he won’t betray the country, urges authorities not to label him as terrorist
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) has arrested four suspected terrorists accused of plotting attacks across several cities, including Lucknow. Investigators revealed that the group had received an offer from Pakistan-based handlers, greater the scale of terror, higher the financial reward. However, one key suspect, Akib Khan, who allegedly connected the group with Pakistani handler Abu Bakar, remains absconding. Akib Khan issues statement from Dubai Akib, a resident of Meerut, is currently in Dubai, from where he has been posting videos on social media denying all allegations. In his statements, he insists that he has no involvement in terrorism and claims he is being falsely implicated. In one video, he said, 'This is our country. We will not betray it, nor will we sell our integrity. Do not label us terrorists, catch those who are guilty.' He further stated that no evidence exists linking him to funding or recruiting individuals. Refuting claims that he facilitated communication between suspects and handlers, he challenged authorities to produce call records as proof. Read the report 'We will not sell our faith' In his videos, Akib emphasised his loyalty to India, stating he would never compromise his faith or country for money. He claimed he has been living in Dubai since 2019, working as a driver and earning a legitimate livelihood. 'I earn my living honestly. I belong to a respectable family. Do not brand me a terrorist,' he said, adding that he is willing to answer any questions if approached directly. Multiple videos shared online Over the past five days, Akib has posted three videos across multiple Instagram accounts, where he has over 40,000 followers. In each, he has maintained his innocence and rejected allegations of involvement in any terror-related activities. In one video, he asserted, 'I love my country deeply. I am a Pathan, I would rather lose my life than bow down. The accusations against me are completely false.' Appeal to PM and CM Akib also appealed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, urging them to ensure a fair investigation. He claimed he had previously cooperated with police and shared accurate information. 'I have nothing to do with this. I drive a car and support my family through hard work. Please catch the real culprits,' he said. Conspiracy to target multiple cities According to ATS investigations, the four arrested suspects, Saqib alias Devil, Vikas Gehlawat alias Raunak, Lokesh alias Babu alias Papla Pandit, and Arbab—were part of a wider conspiracy to carry out blasts in multiple cities following an initial attack in Lucknow. From their possession, authorities recovered a chemical-filled container, seven mobile phones, 24 pamphlets, and Aadhaar cards. During interrogation, Saqib was identified as the mastermind. He reportedly confessed that Akib had introduced him to Pakistani handler Abu Bakar. Instructions from Pakistani handlers ATS officials stated that handlers based in Pakistan provided detailed operational guidance through audio recordings and social media platforms. These included reconnaissance methods, target selection, and execution strategies. The suspects were instructed to leave the state immediately after carrying out attacks. They were also told to record videos of the aftermath and send them back to handlers. Several such audio clips have been recovered from their mobile phones. How did ATS uncover the network ? The investigation began with an arson incident in Bijnor on 4 March 2026, when a pickup van belonging to Nimish Rastogi was set on fire. Police arrested Abuzar and Zaid on 12 March in connection with the case. During questioning, it emerged that Abuzar was facing financial difficulties and had sought help from his cousin, Mohammad Zaid. Zaid connected him with Abu Bakar through Telegram. Under instructions, Abuzar targeted vehicles belonging to the Hindu community and set fire to a van near a temple. He recorded the act and sent the video to the handler, after which money was transferred to his account. Further investigation revealed that Zaid was part of 12 Telegram groups linked to such activities. Both the ATS and the National Investigation Agency (NIA) are now probing the case. Surveillance and links to Akib As the investigation progressed, links between Saqib and Abu Bakar were uncovered. ATS then placed Saqib’s mobile number under surveillance, leading to the unravelling of the broader network. Akib’s alleged role as an intermediary connecting local operatives to foreign handlers has become a key focus of the probe. Action against police officials The case has also led to disciplinary action against two police officials. A complaint had been filed on 23 November 2025 at Najibabad police station against Maizul, Akib, and an unidentified individual. The then Station House Officer, Satyendra Singh Malik, contacted Maizul and arranged a video call with Akib. During the call, Akib dismissed concerns, claiming that what appeared to be an AK-47 was merely a toy and that a suspected grenade was actually a perfume bottle. Accepting this explanation, the police filed a final report, effectively giving them a clean chit. However, following recent developments, the SSP suspended SHO Malik and attached Circle Officer Nitesh Pratap Singh to the police lines on 5 April. With multiple agencies involved and fresh leads emerging, the case continues to unfold. Authorities are focusing on tracing financial transactions, digital communications, and international links to dismantle the network completely.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav shown as 'Rehman Dakait' in hoardings:Youth Against Mafia's posters asks, 'Lyari Raj or Dhurandhar CM, what do you want?'
stories.summary: The film ‘Dhurandhar 2’ has triggered a political storm in Uttar Pradesh. Controversy has erupted over the portrayal of a character resembling mafia don Atiq Ahmed, shown as having links with Pakistan’s intelligence agency ISI and a terrorist organisation. Opposition parties, including the Samajwadi Party (SP), have termed it BJP propaganda. Meanwhile, hoardings targeting SP chief Akhilesh Yadav have appeared across Lucknow. Hoardings target Akhilesh Yadav In hoardings installed at several locations, Akhilesh has been depicted as ‘Rehman Dakait’, the villain from the film Dhurandhar. The caption reads, ‘Akhilesh’s Lyari Raj’. On one side of the hoarding is an image of Yogi Adityanath performing Kanya Pujan, labelled ‘Dhurandhar CM’. The hoarding poses the question, ‘What do you want?’ ‘Youth Against Mafia’ campaign The hoardings, put up by an organisation named ‘Youth Against Mafia’, feature news clippings beneath Akhilesh’s image highlighting riots during his tenure in Muzaffarnagar, Meerut and Shamli. On the opposite side, under CM Yogi’s image, are clippings of action taken against mafias such as Atiq Ahmed and Mukhtar Ansari. Installed across key locations in Lucknow These hoardings have been installed at major intersections across Lucknow, including areas around the Chief Minister’s residence. Their appearance has intensified political debate and drawn attention from passers-by and local residents. The hoardings also display the names and photographs of office bearers of ‘Youth Against Mafia’, including Executive President Ashutosh Singh and General Secretary Abhinav Tiwari. The riots during the SP government have been labelled as ‘Lyari Raj’. SP tenure labelled ‘Lyari Raj’ Through these displays, a direct attack has been made on the SP by referencing riots in Muzaffarnagar, Meerut and Shamli. By terming these incidents ‘Lyari Raj’, the hoardings attempt to suggest weak law and order during that period. CM Yogi projected as ‘Dhurandar’ In contrast, the hoardings highlight actions against organised crime, projecting Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath as ‘Dhurandar’. Newspaper clippings related to cases involving Atiq Ahmed, Mukhtar Ansari and Mukim Kala have been included to underline a message of strict law enforcement.

stories.title: Drivers will not feel drowsy on Ganga Expressway:Rest facilities available at every 75 km; Meerut to Prayagraj journey cut to 6 hours
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh’s 594 km-long Ganga Expressway is nearing completion, with finishing work currently underway. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to inaugurate it soon. Once operational, the expressway will connect western UP to eastern regions, reducing travel time between Meerut and Prayagraj to just six hours, compared to the current 11–12 hours. The expressway is equipped with several advanced public convenience facilities, including rest areas, trauma centres for medical emergencies, and food courts. Rumble strips have been installed along the road, raised markings that create vibrations when tyres pass over them, alerting drivers and reducing the risk of accidents caused by fatigue. Fuel stations are already operational, toll plaza staff have been deployed, signage has been installed, and speed monitoring systems are active. Before its public opening, a ground report journey from Meerut to Prayagraj was conducted to assess readiness. Route and entry restrictions Named after the Ganga River, the expressway passes through 12 districts located along its basin. It begins near Bijauli village, about 7 km from Meerut, at the Hapur border. National Highway-334, connecting Meerut to Haridwar, Saharanpur, and Bulandshahr, also passes nearby. Entry and exit points were found closed during the visit due to security concerns, as bikers had begun entering the expressway for stunts. Officials clarified that only cars and heavy vehicles will be permitted, with motorcycles prohibited. High-speed corridor and toll system After obtaining permission from UPEDA, the journey began, with vehicles quickly reaching speeds of 110 km/h on the largely empty stretch. The first toll plaza was encountered in Meerut. Officials stated that there will be two main toll plazas, one in Meerut and another in Prayagraj. Additionally, 15 ramp toll plazas have been constructed at entry and exit points across districts, allowing access after toll payment. Proposed toll rates have already been determined. Rumble strips to prevent fatigue About 20 km into the journey, noticeable vibrations were felt in the vehicle. These were caused by rumble strips placed along the road edges. Such strips are designed to counter driver fatigue caused by long, uninterrupted high-speed driving. The vibration alerts drivers who may be drowsy, helping prevent accidents. These strips extend across the entire stretch from Meerut to Prayagraj. PPP model and fuel infrastructure The expressway has been developed under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model and divided into four sections. The Meerut to Badaun stretch was constructed by Ideal Road Builders Infrastructure, while the remaining three sections, from Badaun to Hardoi, Hardoi to Unnao, and Unnao to Prayagraj, were developed by Adani Enterprises, accounting for 75% of the project. A total of nine public convenience centres have been built along the route. These include petrol pumps, food plazas, cafeterias, dormitories, hotel facilities, and trauma centres. Fuel stations are available every 75 km, making this the first expressway in UP where fuel infrastructure is operational even before public opening. All petrol pumps are operated directly by Bharat Petroleum under the company-owned, company-operated (COCO) model. Flexible stay and emergency healthcare Food plazas offer affordable options, while dormitories and hotel rooms are available for drivers and passengers. Unlike traditional hotels, payments are calculated on an hourly basis rather than a fixed 24-hour charge. Primary health centres have been established near toll plazas. According to staff, emergency response time is targeted at 20 minutes. Ambulances are equipped with oxygen cylinders, first-aid medicines, and life-saving equipment. Serious cases will be transferred to trauma centres. Engineering challenges: Ramganga Bridge In Badaun, the expressway features a 720-metre-long bridge over the Ramganga river. Construction posed significant challenges due to riverbank erosion. Initially, the river flowed 200 metres away from the bridge site but later changed course, damaging nearby areas. Engineers eventually diverted the flow and completed the structure at a cost of ₹122 crore. Airstrip for defence operations At Jalalabad in Shahjahanpur, a 3.5 km airstrip has been developed along the expressway. The stretch has removable dividers, allowing it to function as a runway during wartime. Fighter jets can land here even at night. See day and night pictures of the plane landing - On 2 May 2025, the Indian Air Force conducted landing and take-off exercises involving 16 aircraft, including Rafale, Sukhoi, Mirage-2000, MiG-29, Jaguar, and transport aircraft such as Hercules, AN-32, and Mi-17-V5. This airstrip enhances operational readiness, serves as an alternative runway if airbases are compromised, and aids disaster management by enabling rapid deployment of relief materials and personnel. Connectivity and endpoint Travelling through Shahjahanpur, Hardoi, Unnao, and Rae Bareli, the route connects with improved highways, including the Lucknow–Prayagraj four-lane corridor. The expressway ends near Judapur Dandu, about 15 km before Prayagraj, where National Highway-19 (Delhi–Kolkata route) passes underneath. From this junction, Prayagraj can be accessed directly, while Varanasi is reachable within two hours via NH-19. Ayodhya, located about 160 km away, is also well connected, boosting religious tourism. Cost, expansion and economic impact The foundation stone was laid by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 18 December 2021 in Shahjahanpur. The project cost is approximately ₹37,350 crore, with an average cost of ₹62.87 crore per kilometre. Around ₹9,500 crore was spent on land acquisition, with farmers receiving compensation up to four times the circle rate. Land prices near Bijauli have already surged, and an industrial corridor is planned in the area. The expressway reduces the Meerut–Prayagraj distance from 684 km (via Kanpur) to 594 km. It also eliminates the need to travel via Lucknow to access the Agra Expressway for Delhi-bound journeys. Plans are underway to extend it to Haridwar. The corridor will improve connectivity across districts, including Pratapgarh, Rae Bareli, Unnao, Shahjahanpur, Hardoi, Badaun, Amroha, Sambhal, Bulandshahr, and Hapur. Key benefits across sectors Real Estate: Improved connectivity is expected to drive up land prices, particularly in residential sectors. Religious Tourism: Easier access to Prayagraj, Varanasi, Garhmukteshwar, Haridwar, and Ayodhya will boost pilgrim movement. Victims, after losing money on these platforms, were pressured into organ donation with promises of ₹20–25 lakh in return. If they resisted, they were sent research papers from universities in the United States and London, highlighting cases of people living healthy lives with a single kidney. Gradually brainwashed, many victims agreed to undergo surgery. Ayush Kumar, one such victim, had his kidney removed following the same pattern. A mule bank account in his name was opened at a Delhi bank, and police are now tracing financial transactions. Statements of jailed agent Shivam Agarwal are set to be recorded. Over 50 transplants raise alarm Investigations have revealed that more than 50 kidney transplants were conducted in Kanpur alone. Police have arrested nine individuals, including doctors and operating theatre technicians, while six more suspects have been identified and are being pursued. The scale of the operation raised critical questions about how donors were sourced. During questioning, Ayush’s mobile phone records exposed key details of the network and its methods. Telegram gaming trap operated by doctors Police investigations indicate that two doctors, Dr Afzal and Dr Mudassir Ali, created groups on the Telegram messaging app. These groups circulated links to task-based gaming platforms. Players were required to create accounts and were initially encouraged with bonus funds and easy wins. At the outset, participants were allowed to earn small amounts, which were credited to their accounts. However, as they progressed, the tasks became increasingly difficult, requiring higher financial investments. Gradually, players began losing money. At regular intervals, messages appeared urging them to borrow funds to continue playing. Many took loans in the hope of recovering losses, only to fall deeper into debt. From Debt to Coercion: ‘Sell your kidney’ Once individuals were financially distressed, gang members contacted them, demanding repayment. During these conversations, victims were persuaded to consider kidney donation as a solution. They were told that the human body has two kidneys and that one could be donated without affecting quality of life. The gang promised payments of ₹20–25 lakh, suggesting victims could repay debts and lead comfortable lives. According to DCP West SM Qasim Abidi, psychological pressure played a key role. Victims were sent curated studies claiming people born with one kidney lived normal lives. This systematic conditioning eventually led to consent for surgery. In Ayush Kumar’s case from Begusarai, Bihar, he was convinced to donate his kidney for ₹9.5 lakh. Ayush’s messages reveal distress WhatsApp messages sent by Ayush to Dr Afzal reveal the emotional toll. He expressed regret over wasted time, inability to focus on exams, and mounting distress. He requested to withdraw from the process and repay ₹6,000 gradually over two to three months. He also mentioned delays in the surgery and refused a longer waiting period of 30–40 days, stating that timely completion mattered more than higher payment. Role of key agent Parvez Saifi Police are bringing Parvez Saifi from Meerut to Kanpur. He allegedly facilitated the movement of doctors for transplant procedures. During Parul Tomar’s transplant, Parvez brought Dr Rohit’s team and stayed in Kanpur for 10 days. His involvement has been traced across several of the 50 known operations. Parvez has a criminal history, with cases of robbery in Meerut and Baghpat, dacoity in Ghaziabad, and attempted murder. During Parul’s transplant, her husband Vikas Tomar and brother Divyank Ahuja were present. However, Vikas left before a police raid, while Divyank remained. Vikas has not appeared before investigators since. After the procedure, ₹22 lakh was reportedly paid to Dr Afzal. Authorities believe a viral video showing bundles of cash may be linked to this transaction. From hospital guard to network operator A key figure, Ajay, emerged during the investigation. He had previously worked as a guard at Hallet Hospital under a compassionate appointment scheme. After one year, he opened Star Hospital in Keshavpuram, Kalyanpur, employing Dr Rohan and Dr Narendra. Later, these doctors, along with Sandeep from Kannauj, established Medilife Hospital in Maswanpur. Sandeep remains absconding. Ajay stated that most cases at his hospital were abortions and that financial losses in 2022–23 forced its closure. He admitted introducing the doctors to agent Shivam Kada, after which kidney transplants began at Medilife Hospital. However, Ajay denied knowledge of financial arrangements between the parties. After three hours of questioning, the police issued him a notice and released him. Authorities are also investigating the role of a South African woman named Arabica, whose video recently surfaced. Police believe agent Shivam Agarwal is a crucial link in identifying her. He was seen examining someone with a stethoscope in the footage. Officials have contacted the South African embassy to verify her identity, visa details, and travel history. Preliminary findings suggest she met gang members in Delhi, but further details remain unclear. Expanding investigation across states DCP Abidi described Shivam Agarwal as the central link in the network. Police have sought a seven-day remand to extract further information. He is expected to be taken to Meerut and Delhi for additional questioning. Another agent, Naveen Pandey from Prayagraj, has also been identified. When police visited his residence in Kanpur, his family claimed he worked at a battery company and was unaware of his alleged involvement. Investigators believe he managed hospital arrangements for illegal transplants in the Delhi-NCR region. Hospitals under scanner Police have identified nine hospitals across four cities, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Lucknow, and Kanpur, linked to the racket. Letters have been sent to Chief Medical Officers in these districts, and their roles are under investigation. Nationwide probe intensifies The cyber team has traced a key suspect to Maharashtra, prompting the deployment of a police team. Another team visited Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital in Lucknow to question Ayush further. During the inquiry, it emerged that Ayush had initially provided false information about studying at Graphic Era University, Dehradun. He later admitted he is a student of Uttaranchal University. The investigation continues to unravel a complex network combining cyber fraud, psychological manipulation, and illegal organ trade.

stories.title: Shikshamitras to get ₹18,000 per month in UP:Madrasa teacher recruitment to be done via commission; 22 proposals approved in cabinet
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet on Tuesday approved 22 proposals. Basic Education Minister Sandeep Singh announced an increase in honorarium for Shikshamitras and instructors. Shikshamitras will now receive ₹18,000 per month, while instructors will get ₹17,000. He stated that the revised pay has been effective from 1 April, with increased payments set to be credited from 1 May. Earlier, instructors received ₹9,000 and Shikshamitras ₹10,000 per month. The state currently has 1,42,229 Shikshamitras and 24,000 instructors. Madrasa recruitment and new guidelines The Cabinet also approved that recruitment of teachers in government-aided madrasas will now be conducted through the Education Service Selection Commission. This means candidates will be required to pass an examination, replacing the earlier system of recruitment at the madrasa level. New operational guidelines for madrasas will also be introduced. These include a mandatory eight-hour study schedule, similar to regular schools. Online attendance will be recorded for principals, teachers and students, and a comprehensive database of students will be maintained. 1. Beautification of statues of social reformers Minister Asim Arun announced that under the ‘Dr B.R. Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme’, statues of eminent personalities who contributed to social reform will be upgraded and beautified at public places. Works will include installation of canopies, boundary structures and overall beautification around statues of Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar and other reformers. Around ₹10 lakh will be spent per statue, with ₹1 crore allocated per विधानसभा constituency. Detailed guidelines for the scheme will be released on 14 April. No new statues will be installed; instead, existing statues set up until 31 December 2025 will be upgraded. This includes statues of Sant Ravidas, Kabirdas, Jyotiba Phule and other prominent social reformers across communities. It was also stated that during the Samajwadi Party government, statues and memorials of such leaders had been disrespected. 2. Land rights for displaced families Finance Minister Suresh Khanna said that 12,000 families who migrated from Pakistan during Partition have been granted land ownership rights. This includes 4,000 families in Pilibhit, 2,350 in Lakhimpur Kheri, 3,856 in Bijnor and 2,170 in Rampur. Additionally, 99 displaced Hindu families will receive land in Kanpur on a lease of ₹1. 3. Approval for tablet procurement and investment proposals Alok Kumar, Additional Chief Secretary of the Industrial Development Department, said approval has been granted for a tender to procure 25 lakh tablets. So far, 60 lakh tablets have been distributed under the Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme. A total of eight proposals from the department have been cleared, including provisions for subsidies to investors. 4. 49 bus stands to be developed on PPP model Transport Minister Dayashankar Singh stated that three proposals from the Transport Department have been approved. The government will develop 49 bus stands under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. Earlier, approval had been granted for 23 such bus stands. The aim is to ensure at least one PPP-based bus stand in every district, with an estimated investment of ₹4,000 crore. Land transfer proposals have also been approved. Land in Ratanpur Husainpur village will be provided free of cost for a bus station in Sikandrarao, Hathras. Similarly, land from the Irrigation Department in Narora, Bulandshahr, will be used for a bus station and depot workshop, while Public Works Department land in Tulsipur tehsil of Balrampur will be used for a bus stand. 5. New university in Gorakhpur The Forest Minister announced that a Horticulture and Forestry University will be established in Gorakhpur. The project will cost ₹491.0777 crore and will be developed over 50 hectares in the Campierganj area. The university will offer BSc, MSc, PhD and diploma courses. stories.title: Girl dragged, forced onto bike in Fatehpur:Harassment on busy road caught on video, accused claims she is his girlfriend
stories.summary: In Fatehpur, on Tuesday evening, a 20-year-old boy molested an 18-year-old student in the middle of the road. He forcibly stopped the student, snatched her bag, and insisted on making her sit on his bike. The girl continuously asked him to let her go, but he refused. Seeing the commotion, people gathered around. Some started making videos. Seeing this, the accused got agitated. He threatened people and asked them not to make videos. He said, "She is my girlfriend. This is our personal matter. Stay away." People complained to the Chief Minister on social media. After this, the police arrested the accused boy. The incident took place 300 meters away from the Abunagar police outpost. First, see 2 pictures Now read the full case in detail The incident is from the Abunagar area, under Kotwali police station. On Tuesday evening, a boy arrived there on a Splendor bike. Soon after, he started molesting the girl. He dragged the girl to the bike and insisted on making her sit on it. The girl continuously refused, but he did not listen. During this, he grabbed the girl's bag and started pulling it. The girl kept trying to free her bag. She pleaded to be let go, but the boy kept dragging the bag. This commotion continued at the intersection for a long time. Fled on threat of calling police A crowd of people gathered around. When people protested, the boy started threatening them. When people in the crowd mentioned calling the police on Dial 100, he fled from the spot. After this, the girl's family took her home with them. The girl is a third-year BA student. Her house is about 3 kilometers away from the incident site. The accused has been identified as Aman Syed alias Jordan. He is a resident of Uttar Kheldar. His father has passed away. His family includes his mother and a sister. Police registered the case themselves After the incident, the girl's family was unwilling to say anything and did not file any complaint. However, the matter reached social media. People tagged the CM on X and demanded action. After this, the police sprang into action. Chowki Incharge Gulab Maurya took cognizance of the video and registered the case himself. Police took action as soon as the video went viral SP Abhimanyu Manglik said that on Tuesday evening around 5 PM in the Abunagar area, Aman Sayyed alias Jordan publicly stopped a girl. He was molesting her and trying to forcibly pull her onto his bike while making obscene gestures. When the girl resisted, the accused abused her and also threatened to kill her. After the video of the incident went viral, the police registered a case against the accused under sections 126(2), 75, 352, and 351(2) of the BNS. He was arrested from his home during a raid around 2 AM on Wednesday night. The accused has been sent to jail.

stories.title: UP orders salary hike for Shiksha Mitras, instructors:Effective from 1 April; 1.67 lakh workers to benefit
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has issued an order increasing the honorarium of Shiksha Mitras and instructors, benefiting around 1.67 lakh personnel across the state. The order was released on Thursday evening. Under the revised structure, Shiksha Mitras will now receive ₹18,000 per month, up from ₹10,000, while instructors’ honorarium has been raised from ₹9,000 to ₹17,000 per month. The hike is effective from 1 April and the increased payments will start reflecting in bank accounts from 1 May. Currently, there are 1,42,229 Shiksha Mitras and 24,717 instructors in the state. This marks the first salary hike for Shiksha Mitras in nine years. Additional benefits and policy announcements Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had recently announced that Shiksha Mitras would also be eligible for transfers. Additionally, they and their families will receive cashless medical treatment coverage of up to ₹5 lakh. The proposal to increase the honorarium was approved in a cabinet meeting earlier this week. Subsequently, Additional Chief Secretary Parth Sarathi Sen Sharma issued the official order to the Director General of School Education. Read the government's order Political row ahead of elections The salary hike has sparked political debate ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav criticized the move, claiming that during his tenure, Shiksha Mitras effectively earned up to ₹40,000. He alleged that the current hike was driven by electoral fears and termed it insufficient after years of “harassment.” In a letter addressed to Shiksha Mitras, Yadav urged them to mobilize against the ruling BJP in the upcoming elections. He also demanded that the government clear pending dues from previous years. Legal and Policy background on instructors’ pay In 2017, instructors’ honorarium was proposed to be increased from around ₹9,000 to ₹17,000, but the decision was not implemented after a change in government. Following a legal battle, the Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court initially ordered payment of ₹17,000 with 9% interest. The state government challenged the order, and a division bench limited the payment to one year. The matter eventually reached the Supreme Court. On February 5, the Supreme Court dismissed the state government’s appeal and directed that instructors should continue in service even after the contractual period, noting that their positions effectively became permanent after long-term service. It also ordered implementation of the ₹17,000 honorarium from 2017. Shiksha Mitras’ journey: From appointment to legal setbacks The appointment of Shiksha Mitras in Uttar Pradesh began in 2001. During the Samajwadi Party government (2013–14), many were adjusted as assistant teachers. However, in 2015, the Allahabad High Court cancelled these appointments. The matter went to the Supreme Court, which, on July 25, 2017, upheld the cancellation. As a result, around 1.78 lakh assistant teachers were reverted to Shiksha Mitra positions, with their salaries dropping sharply from about ₹50,000 to ₹3,500 per month. This triggered widespread protests, including a major agitation in Lucknow. Following this, the government increased their honorarium to ₹10,000 per month and announced teacher recruitment drives. Subsequent recruitment drives in 2018 (68,500 posts) and 2019 (69,000 posts) offered age relaxation and bonus marks to Shiksha Mitras, enabling over 13,000 of them to become assistant teachers.

stories.title: FIR filed against officer hiding ₹17 crore in mattress, bathroom:Kanpur sees action after 9 years; spent 12 times his earnings
stories.summary: A case has been registered against Keshav Lal, a retired Additional Commissioner of the Sales Tax Department in Kanpur, for possessing assets disproportionate to his income. The FIR was filed 9 years later on April 8 by the Kanpur Vigilance team. 9 years ago, in 2017, Keshav was posted in Kanpur. During that time, the Income Tax Department raided his homes in Noida and Kanpur. Bundles of notes were found hidden in mattresses, bathroom flushes, and cardboard boxes. A total of 10 crore cash and 3 crore worth of jewelry were found in Noida, while 4 crore cash was found in Kanpur. In addition, immovable properties worth crores were also discovered. Following this, the Vigilance Department was investigating Keshav. Now, after the completion of the investigation, an FIR has been registered. Now know the full story Keshav Lal lived in a rented house in Kanpur Keshav Lal, originally from Bamhaniyao village in Chandauli district, currently lives in Sector-34, Noida. In 2017, he was posted in Kanpur. According to vigilance, Keshav Lal lived in a rented house in the Lakhanpur area of Kanpur. The rent for the house he lived in was around 10 thousand rupees. It had 2 rooms, 2 bathrooms, a kitchen, and a dining space. However, Keshav Lal mostly lived alone here. His family lived in Noida. Keshav has two children - a son and a daughter. He got his daughter married in December 2016 in Noida. Income Tax Department raided on April 19, 2017 The Income Tax Department raided his homes in Noida and Kanpur on April 19, 2017. Approximately 4 crore rupees were found in the rented house in Kanpur. Meanwhile, approximately 10 crore rupees in cash and 3 crore rupees worth of jewellery were recovered from the Noida house. In Noida, bundles of notes were found from the mattresses, puja room, wardrobe, and unused flush of the bathroom. Additionally, 3 cartons full of notes were found in the bedroom. Subsequently, Keshav Lal was given compulsory retirement in May 2017. Along with this, the investigation of the case was handed over to Vigilance. Since then, an investigation into his properties has been ongoing. On January 6, 2026, Vigilance submitted its investigation report From September 19, 2023, the Vigilance Department rapidly initiated an investigation against the then Additional Commissioner (Grade-2) Commercial Tax, Keshav Lal. During the investigation, documents of several valuable properties were found in Keshav Lal's home district, Chandauli, as well as in Kanpur, Prayagraj, Ghaziabad, and Noida. He owns 2 properties in Lucknow, and one each in Kanpur, Prayagraj, Ghaziabad, and Noida, all valued at crores. After the completion of the investigation, Vigilance officers submitted their report on January 6, 2026. Following this, approval was given to register a report against Keshav Lal. Subsequently, a case was registered in Kanpur on April 8, 2026. According to the Vigilance FIR, Keshav Lal earned a total income of approximately 1 crore 34 lakh from legitimate sources throughout his government career. However, the investigation revealed that he spent approximately 18 crore 27 lakh rupees. Thus, assets and expenses were approximately 17 crore 26 lakh rupees more than his income were found.

stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Green Asha, carrying 15,400 tonnes of LPG, docks at Mumbai Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) on Thursday received the India-flagged LPG vessel Green Asha, carrying 15,400 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas. The ship successfully crossed the Strait of Hormuz. It has now docked at JNPA’s liquid berth operated by BPCL-IOCL. 2. Mafia Ashraf’s aide killed in broad daylight: Shot at a tea shop in Prayagraj The incident occurred around 6:30 PM near Bismillah Chowk. Irfan was sitting at a tea shop close to his house when four attackers arrived on two motorcycles. All had covered their faces with gamchas. 3. An Amity student drowned in a water-filled pit in Noida: Went for a picnic after exams A 23-year-old student of Amity University in Noida, Harshit Bhatt, died after drowning in a water-filled pit on Wednesday evening. Harshit had gone for a picnic with three friends after finishing his exams. During the outing, he entered the pit, went into the deeper section and began to drown. 4. Robot in traditional saree welcomes voters; Puducherry tops voter turnout at 89.81% Polling has concluded in a single phase today for Assembly elections in the states of Assam and Kerala, and the Union Territory of Puducherry. Voter turnout stands at 85.38% in Assam, 78.01% in Kerala, 89.81% in Puducherry. 5.15 accused, multi-city kidney racket: The doctor brought a surgical team from Meerut A large-scale illegal kidney transplant racket, originating from Ahuja Hospital in Kanpur, has exposed a well-organised network spanning nine hospitals across four cities in Uttar Pradesh. 6. AAP to lose by sidelining Raghav Chadha, says Avimukteshwaranand: Calls him ‘An asset to the country’ Swami Avimukteshwaranand has entered the ongoing row between the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and its Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha, calling Chadha “an asset to the nation” and saying the party may be harming itself. 7. PM Modi gives 6 guarantees to Bengal, including the 7th Pay Commission Prime Minister outlined six major assurances for the people of West Bengal, focusing on justice, accountability, and effective governance under a BJP government, which includes implementing the 7th pay commission in the state, curbing infiltrators and protecting women. 8. 'Now I have to support my national-level player daughter ': Mother alleges son-in-law tried to hang daughter in Kashi “Ask a mother. The daughter who once supported me, I have been supporting her for the last 10 months. She used to bring home medals. Today, I am asking for justice for her, which we have not received so far. Her husband left her to die and is now threatening us, too. 9. UP farmer breaks down as hailstorm destroys crop: Hail blankets Hardoi, alert in 44 districts A farmer in Hardoi broke down in tears after seeing his crop destroyed by rain and hail. Unseasonal storms, rain and hail continue to batter Uttar Pradesh. The weather department has issued a rain alert for 44 districts on Thursday, warning of strong winds reaching speeds of up to 60 kmph. 10. Centre criticises Sabarimala verdict in the Supreme Court Supreme Court ruled that the 2018 Sabarimala verdict was based on the notion that men are superior and women inferior. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta supported restrictions on women’s entry to religious sites.

stories.title: 47 police officers transferred in UP:ASP Ayush Vikram Singh moved from Gonda to Bahraich; Twinkle Jain posted to Prayagraj Commissionerate
stories.summary: IPS officers have been transferred in the state. Sagar Jain of IPS-RR-2019 batch has been made Deputy Commissioner of Police, Police Commissionerate Prayagraj, from Additional Superintendent of Police (Rural) Saharanpur. Manoj Kumar Rawat of IPS-RR-2020 batch has been sent from Additional Superintendent of Police (East) Gonda to Additional Superintendent of Police (South) Sambhal, while Ayush Vikram Singh has been posted from Additional Superintendent of Police (City) Meerut to Additional Superintendent of Police (City) Bahraich. Vinayak Gopal Bhosle of IPS-RR-2022 batch has been made Additional Superintendent of Police (City) Meerut from Assistant Superintendent of Police Sitapur, Antariksh Jain from Assistant Superintendent of Police Meerut to Additional Superintendent of Police (Rural) Bulandshahr, Twinkle Jain from Assistant Commissioner of Police Gautam Buddh Nagar to Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Lucknow, and Lipi Nagayach has been made Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Varanasi from Assistant Commissioner of Police Ghaziabad. In this sequence, Rajkumar Meena has been appointed from Assistant Commissioner of Police Prayagraj to Additional Superintendent of Police (Naxal) Mirzapur, Rishabh Runwal from Assistant Commissioner of Police Lucknow to Additional Superintendent of Police (Naxal) Sonbhadra, Alok Kumar from Assistant Superintendent of Police Sambhal to Additional Superintendent of Police (City East) Pratapgarh, Dr. Ishan Soni from Assistant Commissioner of Police Varanasi to Additional Superintendent of Police Jalaun, and Mayank Pathak from Assistant Superintendent of Police Aligarh to Additional Superintendent of Police (Rural) Saharanpur. stories.title: Major husband in depression after wife dances post-divorce:Posted in Jalandhar; in-laws say, 'Daughter-in-law broke court agreement, defamed us'
stories.summary: In Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, the husband of Pranita Sharma, the woman who danced to the beat of drums after divorce, is a Major in the Army and is posted in Jalandhar. His parents, residing at Jalandhar Cantt, have stated that their son Major Gaurav Agnihotri has been in depression since the divorce. They said that daughter-in-law Pranita is lying. She has snatched his child from our son and our grandson from us. With a choked voice, the Major's father said - she has taken away my right to be a grandfather. When the daughter-in-law had an operation and her leg was broken, the mother-in-law massaged and served her, and this is the reward we got. By breaking the court agreement, we are being defamed across the entire country. Major's parents decline harassment charges The Major's parents said that their son is in the Army, which has a discipline. Women cannot be harassed here. Within a minute of a complaint, the army takes action against its soldier. The father said that the daughter-in-law is lying on the strength of her advocate brothers and judge father. She has already filed a case in 2019 as well. On December 14, 2018, UP's Shahjahanpur Army Major Gaurav Agnihotri married Pranita Sharma from Meerut. Pranita demanded divorce alleging harassment at her in-laws' place and on April 4, 2026, the court granted the divorce. As soon as she got the divorce, Pranita danced to the beat of drums. The video of this went viral rapidly on the internet. The Major's father said these things about the case The Major's mother stated 3 important points Know what the maternal family told about the whole matter... Retired judge Gyanendra Sharma in Meerut said - My daughter Pranita Sharma's in-laws' behavior has not been good since after marriage. In 7 years, she endured many hardships. Her husband and in-laws started harassing her. During this time, she also had a son, but even after the child's birth, the situation did not change. The in-laws troubled her mentally and physically. Finally, Pranita decided to take a divorce. She filed a petition in Meerut Family Court. On April 4, the court granted the divorce. After this, the family has brought daughter Pranita Sharma back home with full respect. Father said - She is my daughter, not some commodity Father Gyanendra Sharma said - If my daughter was unhappy in her marriage, it was my responsibility to give her happiness. My daughter left for her wedding with pomp and show. Today I have brought her back with the same respect. I did not take any alimony or belongings from those people. He said that forcing a daughter to stay at her in-laws' house at any cost is wrong. A daughter is not a commodity, she is part of the family. Women's empowerment should not remain limited to papers only. It is necessary to implement it on the ground. Pranita Sharma said - First make yourself strong, study and educate yourself Pranita Sharma is the Finance Director at Pranav Vashishth Judicial Academy located in Shastri Nagar, Meerut. She has done post-graduation in Psychology. She is the only daughter of her parents. Her brother died in an accident in 2022. Pranita shared that she had become mentally very weak, but her family stood by her at all times. With this support, she managed to pull herself together. She said - If any woman is facing any kind of harassment, don't stay silent. Fight for yourself. First make yourself strong. Study, educate yourself, stand on your own feet. Only after that think about marriage. Taking forward the spirit of 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' (Save the Daughter, Educate the Daughter), she said that making daughters educated and self-reliant is the real women empowerment.

stories.title: Brother murdered after sister plotted with lover:Caught them together in Mainpuri; husband works in IT firm in Pune
stories.summary: In Mainpuri, a sister, along with her lover, got her own brother murdered. The brother had seen her in an objectionable situation with her lover. When he protested, the lover shot him. The bullet pierced his eye and went through his head. After this, the lover, along with his brother, took the body about one and a half kilometres away from the house to a jungle near the river and dumped it. To mislead the police, the sister also filed a missing person report, but her 10-year-old son exposed his mother and her lover. This incident occurred on Tuesday night, in the Kishni police station area, about 35 kilometers away from the district headquarters. The police have arrested the accused sister and her lover. The deceased was a resident of Farrukhabad and had come to Mainpuri, his sister's in-laws' house, to drop her off. Know the full story Pooja Dubey, sister of Karan Mishra (25) from Karthia village, Farrukhabad, was married to Dilip Dubey, a resident of Kusmara village, Mainpuri, about 15 years ago. Dilip works in an IT company in Pune, Maharashtra. They have three children. The eldest son is 10-year-old Hrithik Dubey. Karan had gone to his sister's in-laws' house in Kusmara on Tuesday to drop her off. Due to it being late at night, he stayed there. Pooja's lover came to meet her at night Ritvik said - Around 12 o'clock at night, my mother's friend Jitendra alias Jitu (38) secretly came to meet her. Then my uncle woke up. When my uncle objected to Jitendra coming home, both of them clashed. There was a fierce fight. My mother was also on Jitendra's side. At my mother's insistence, he shot my uncle. After killing my uncle, Jitendra called his brother Juli. Both of them took his dead body on a bike and went somewhere. My mother threatened me not to tell anyone about this. When a call came from Grandma's house, Mom said- He had already left for home at night. In the morning, Jitendra returned again. Then Mom and Jitendra went to the police station. They left us alone at home. When they didn't return until afternoon, the neighbors asked me- Then I told them the whole story. After that, the neighbors called the police and informed them about the incident. Police arrested him at the station itself After the nephew's revelation, police reached the house based on information from neighbors. Meanwhile, Pooja had arrived at Kishni police station with her lover to file a missing person report for her husband. After the child's statement, the policemen who reached the house informed the police station. Following this, Pooja and her lover were taken into custody at the police station itself. The Kishni police station in-charge stated - On Wednesday morning at 10 AM, Pooja Dubey came to the police station with her lover Jitendra. She was talking about filing a missing person report for her brother Karan. Just then, her neighbors called. Information was received that Pooja, along with her lover, had murdered her brother Karan. Now she is trying to mislead the police. Pooja and Jitendra were taken into custody at the police station itself. Based on their confession, the body was also recovered on Wednesday evening. The body was hidden in the jungle near the river in Dharmgadpur village, about one and a half kilometers away from the house. There was a bullet wound in the head. Based on the statement of 10-year-old child Hrithik, Pooja, Jitendra, and Julie have been arrested. Brother Karan was unmarried; the lover had three children The deceased's elder brother Mohit alias Monu said, "Karan was unmarried. He was preparing for police recruitment. He had taken the Sub-Inspector recruitment exam on March 15-16. The exam went very well. He was hopeful of selection this time. Karan was the fifth among 4 sisters and two brothers." Pooja was the fourth among the siblings. She was married 15 years ago. Pooja has 3 children. She had been having an affair with Jitendra for about 5 years. Jitendra is married and also has three children. SP said - Murder happened due to illicit relations, son exposed it SP City Arun Kumar said- Karan was shot dead due to illicit relations. The youth's murderers have been arrested. Elder sister Pooja, lover Jitendra alias Jeetu, and Jitendra's brother Juli are accused of murder. All three are being interrogated.

stories.title: SP leader targeted with thallium poisoning:Wife files FIR in Varanasi, Mumbai hospital confirms toxin
stories.summary: A case has emerged in Varanasi where an attempt was made to kill an SP leader by poisoning him with thallium. A doctor from a renowned hospital in Mumbai has confirmed the presence of thallium traces in the SP leader's blood. After the investigation report came, the SP leader's wife filed an FIR against unknown persons. On Wednesday, the police registered a case at Varanasi's Kotwali police station on the complaint of Khushboo Singh. SP leader Sandeep Singh (41) has served as the national general secretary of the Samajwadi Chhatra Sabha. According to his wife, he was admitted to Medanta, Gurugram, in February 2025 after his health suddenly deteriorated. As his condition did not improve, he was admitted to Max Hospital Delhi. When there was no benefit there either, he was taken to PD Ahuja Hospital in Mumbai via air ambulance, where doctors confirmed thallium poisoning. Now, who is Sandeep Singh? Sandeep Singh, a resident of Varanasi, has been the National General Secretary of the Samajwadi Chhatra Sabha (Samajwadi Student Assembly). He also operates two transport companies named SSS Infotech Private Limited and Shiv Enterprises. The transport companies are also involved in construction work. The company also handles the transportation of asphalt, gravel, etc., for road construction. Sandeep Singh's family includes his father Ghanshyam Singh, mother Poornima Singh, wife Khushboo Singh, daughter Swapnil, and son Prahan. What are the allegations in the FIR? Wife Khushboo Singh stated in a complaint filed with the police on Wednesday that her husband stayed at Medanta Hospital Gurugram from February 4, 2025, to February 11, 2025, after an acquaintance, Shiv Prasad, fell ill. He returned on February 12 to attend her brother's wedding. After the wedding, he went back to Medanta on February 22. While there, he developed a fever and tingling in his feet on February 26. His condition worsened after body pain and vomiting. After his condition deteriorated further, he was admitted to Medanta Gurugram on March 2, 2025. On March 5, his brother-in-law, Ajit Singh, went to meet him. Doctors stated that the illness was not being identified. Upon receiving information from her brother-in-law, I myself arrived. Could not understand the illness for a month, was put on ventilator support From there, he was admitted to Max Super Speciality Hospital Delhi on March 8, 2025. He remained admitted to Max until March 22, but instead of improving, his condition started to worsen. On March 22, he was shifted to the ICU. As his condition deteriorated further, he was put on a ventilator on March 23. Airlifted to Hinduja Hospital Wife Khushboo Singh said, "We were very worried. Doctors also couldn't understand the illness. After his condition worsened significantly, my husband was brought by air ambulance to P.D. Hinduja Hospital, Mahim, Mumbai." Here, doctors examined. Dr. Medha Dhamane, after seeing the report, stated that thallium poison was found in her husband's blood. This rare poison is used to kill someone. However, he was treated at Hinduja for a few days. After this, he was discharged. Currently, Sandeep is at his home in Lucknow. He is undergoing treatment at home under the supervision of doctors. Police registered an FIR Kotwali Police Station in-charge Dayashankar Singh said- Based on the complaint filed by Khushboo Singh, a case of attempt to murder has been registered under Section 109(1) of BNS. Now know about Thallium. What is Thallium? Thallium is used as a slow poison. Thallium is a very soft substance that can be easily mixed into anything. It is grey in color, but its color fades when exposed to air. It has no taste of its own. This is why if it is mixed in food, the person eating it does not feel any change in the taste of the food, nor does the color of the food change. How does Thallium work? Thallium acts slowly. After consuming it, common symptoms like headache, vomiting, and diarrhea appear. Therefore, no one even thinks that it is the effect of a poison, but slowly, it starts damaging internal organs. First, it weakens the nervous system. It completely destroys the ability to think and comprehend. Memory starts to weaken. After this, it affects the body's muscles. After a few days of use, extreme weakness is felt throughout the body. Within three weeks, the person goes into a coma.

stories.title: Class 9 student gang-raped in Gorakhpur:10 accused committ crime in different hotels; survivor had gone missing 4 months ago
stories.summary: A Class 9 student from Gorakhpur was allegedly subjected to sexual assault by multiple men over a period of time, police said. According to officials, the minor had left home for school at around 9 am on November 1 but did not return, prompting her family to search for her. When their efforts failed, a missing person complaint was lodged at the local police station on November 7. Police registered a case and initiated an investigation. The girl was eventually traced and recovered on March 23. . During interrogation, the student revealed that she had gone away under the influence of a young man. After that, 10 people raped her on different days in various hotels. Police conducted a medical examination of the student, which confirmed the rape. Based on call details, police caught a young man accused of taking the student away. After this, 10 people including hotel operators were taken into custody. On Wednesday, police presented 4 accused in court and sent them to jail. The incident is from Chaurichaura police station area. Student went missing 4 months ago A 14-year-old student from the Chaurichaura area studies in class 9. The student's father works as a laborer in Gujarat. According to police, on November 1, 2025, she had left home to go to school. During this time, she met a young man on the way. It is alleged that the young man lured her and took her with him. When the student did not return home by evening, the family members became worried. They searched extensively in the surrounding areas, but could not find any trace of her. After this, the family members reached the police station and filed a complaint on November 7. The police registered a case against unknown persons and started investigation. After searching for a long time, on March 23, the police recovered the student. After this, when the police examined the student's call details, shocking information came to light. The investigation revealed that she had been taken to several hotels. The police took action and detained 10 accused for questioning. During interrogation, they confessed to their crime. Police are currently questioning 6 people The police arrested accused Kishan alias Bittu, Sameer alias Dilshad, Monu alias Manish Rajbhar and hotel operator Dharmraj and presented them in court, from where all were sent to jail. Meanwhile, six other accused have been detained and the police are questioning them. SP North Gyanendra Kumar informed - After recovering the minor student, her statement was recorded in court. The student has alleged that she was taken to different places and raped by 10 people. Based on this, 4 accused have been arrested and sent to jail. The role of other accused is being investigated.

stories.title: Amity student drowns in water-filled pit in Noida:Went for picnic with friends after exams, slipped into deep water
stories.summary: A 23-year-old student of Amity University in Noida, Harshit Bhatt, died after drowning in a water-filled pit on Wednesday evening. Harshit had gone for a picnic with three friends after finishing his exams. During the outing, he entered the pit, went into the deeper section and began to drown. His friends tried to rescue him but failed. They then alerted the police. Teams reached the spot with divers, pulled him out and rushed him to a hospital, where doctors declared him dead. BPEd student, father posted in Ladakh According to DCP Saad Mian Khan, Harshit was pursuing a Bachelor of Physical Education (BPEd) and was in his sixth semester. His father serves in the Indian Army and is currently posted in Ladakh. He is survived by a brother and a sister. Police said the four students had appeared for an exam earlier and later consumed alcohol before going to an empty plot. They entered the pit to bathe. During questioning, his friends said they had used the pit earlier as well, but this time Harshit moved into deeper water and drowned. Police, along with SDRF and NDRF teams, reached the spot within about 20 minutes of receiving information. He was pulled out and taken to hospital, where he was declared dead. Earlier case: engineer died after car fell into pit This is not the first such incident in Noida. On January 16, 27-year-old software engineer Yuvraj Mehta died after his car fell into a nearly 30-foot-deep, water-filled pit. Around midnight, Yuvraj was driving towards Tata Eureka Park when, due to dense fog, he could not see the road clearly. His car broke through a drain wall near Sector 150 and plunged into a pit dug for a mall basement. He managed to climb onto the roof of the sinking car and called his father, pleading for help. Despite rescue efforts by police, fire services and SDRF teams, his body was recovered after nearly two-and-a-half hours. Safety lapses flagged after earlier death Following the January incident, action was taken against officials. Then Noida Authority CEO Ritu Maheshwari was removed, citing administrative negligence. Yogi Adityanath had ordered an SIT probe into the case. Authorities had directed that water be drained from open pits, barricading be installed and drains be covered within 15 days. However, the latest incident has again raised concerns over safety compliance at such sites.

stories.title: AAP to lose by sidelining Raghav Chadha, says Avimukteshwaranand:Calls him ‘An asset to the country’; MP responds with gratitude
stories.summary: Swami Avimukteshwaranand has entered the ongoing row between the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and its Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha, calling Chadha “an asset to the nation” and saying the party may be harming itself. Speaking in a podcast, the Shankaracharya said Chadha’s political stature has grown beyond the party and is now based on his own work. His remarks come days after AAP removed Chadha from the post of deputy leader in the Rajya Sabha. Chadha shared excerpts of the podcast on social media on Wednesday, writing a note of respect for the Shankaracharya. Shankaracharya backs Raghav Chadha, calls him ‘an asset to the country’ Swami Avimukteshwaranand said Raghav Chadha earned public appreciation for consistently raising issues of ordinary citizens in Parliament. He recalled that Chadha had once called him seeking blessings after the birth of his son. “The way he stood in Parliament and spoke for the common man was appreciated across the country,” he said. At the same time, the seer noted that a political party has the right to decide how it presents issues. “If the party feels matters should be raised in its own way, that is its internal system. No one else can interfere in that,” he added. ‘He has now become a leader beyond party lines’ The Shankaracharya said Chadha’s interventions in Parliament led to action on several public issues, raising expectations among people. “Now he is not limited to a party. He has become an individual identity. Wherever he goes, people will expect him to raise their concerns,” he said. He added that if given an opportunity, the public would continue to support him electorally. “If one platform does not allow him, people will send him from another place to raise their voice,” he said. ‘An asset to the country’ On reports of differences within the Aam Aadmi Party, the Shankaracharya refused to comment on internal decisions. “This is their matter. We are not their advisors and will not give unsolicited advice,” he said. However, he strongly backed Chadha’s leadership. “His future is bright. A person who speaks for the people cannot fail. He is polite, presents facts and is soft-spoken. Such leaders are rare. He is an asset to our country,” he said. ‘Party may be harming itself’ The seer suggested that the party’s move could be counterproductive. “The Aam Aadmi Party may be harming itself. Political calculations may be different, but the public perception about him is positive,” he said, adding that Chadha’s stature has grown significantly. Visit after wedding with Parineeti Chopra The Shankaracharya had visited Chadha’s Delhi residence in October 2024 after his wedding with Parineeti Chopra. He attended a special paduka puja and blessing ceremony, where he was given a ceremonial welcome. Chadha had shared the visit on social media, calling it a memorable moment soon after his marriage.
