stories.title: Yogi announces overhead shelters for Ambedkar statues across state:CM makes announcement on BJP foundation day
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Monday announced that overhead shelters will be installed over every statue of B. R. Ambedkar across the state. He also said statues of Guru Ravidas and Valmiki would be beautified. Announcement on Ambedkar Jayanti preparations Addressing party workers at a BJP Foundation Day event at Ramleela Maidan in Gorakhpur, Yogi said the government has planned statewide activities ahead of Ambedkar Jayanti on April 14. He said BJP workers will clean areas around Ambedkar statues at the booth level a day before and offer floral tributes on April 14. Parks where these statues are installed will also get boundary walls and beautification work. Yogi encouraged party workers to actively participate and share selfies of these activities with the party. First, the pictures Multiple events attended in Gorakhpur During his visit, the Chief Minister participated in three different programs. He hoisted the BJP flag at the Gorakhnath Temple premises, interacted with party members, and administered the oath to nine executive members of the Gorakhpur Press Club. He also inaugurated the Dr. Tej Pratap Shahi Computer Lab and Research Center. CM turns emotional remembering Dr. Shahi Yogi Adityanath became emotional while recalling his association with Dr. Tej Pratap Shahi, a noted educationist and social worker from Gorakhpur, who also served as a Congress district president. Dr. Shahi passed away due to COVID-19 in July 2020. With a choked voice, the Chief Minister shared memories of his last meeting with him. Political significance of the announcement The announcement is being seen as politically significant ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Opposition parties like Congress and the Samajwadi Party have been actively marking anniversaries of Dalit icons such as Kanshi Ram, Jagjivan Ram, and Ambedkar to consolidate Dalit voters. Dalits constitute around 20.7% of Uttar Pradesh’s population (approximately 41.4 million), making them a crucial voting bloc. Key highlights from Yogi’s speech 1. “India’s progress will not be accepted by its enemies” Yogi said India’s rise will not be accepted by its adversaries, who will spread misinformation and create conspiracies. He said the BJP has faced several challenges, including the Emergency, and responded to political conspiracies. He also paid tribute to Syama Prasad Mukherjee for his sacrifice. 2. “Cleaning political dirt is also necessary” Emphasising cleanliness, he said filth causes disease and must be removed. In an apparent dig at the opposition, he added that “political dirt” is also dangerous for the country and must be cleaned through sustained efforts. 3. “BJP delivers on its promises” The Chief Minister said the BJP works without discrimination based on caste or region and ensures benefits reach everyone. He cited the abrogation of Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir and the construction of the Ram Temple as examples of fulfilled promises under leaders like Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Lal Krishna Advani. Dalit demographics in Uttar Pradesh Dalits in Uttar Pradesh comprise 66 sub-castes, with six major groups accounting for 87% of the population. The Jatav community is the most influential and is considered the core voter base of the BSP. Non-Jatav Dalits—including Pasi, Kori, Dhobi, Khatik, and Valmiki communities—are more fragmented. The BJP expanded its support among non-Jatav groups between 2017 and 2024, though some shift toward the INDIA alliance was seen in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.

stories.title: Sunanda Sharma’s show in Bareilly turns chaotic:Students break barricades, rush toward stage for selfies
stories.summary: Indian Punjabi singer Sunanda Sharma's live performance at Future University in Bareilly turned chaotic on Sunday night after students created a ruckus, attempting to get closer to the stage and take selfies with the artist. Chaos erupts during live performance The incident occurred around 9:30 PM during the university’s “Future Fest,” where more than 10,000 students had gathered at the open ground. As Sunanda Sharma began performing popular songs like “Meri Mummy Nu Pasand Naiyo Tu,” “Jaani Tera Naa,” and “Chandigarh Ka Chhora,” excited fans surged toward the stage. Some students tried to breach security barricades to get a closer view of the singer. When security personnel intervened, the situation escalated, leading to pushing, shouting, and students climbing over the barricades. See 5 pictures- Police step in, use mild force As the crowd became unruly, police personnel present at the venue stepped in. They used batons to warn students and pushed them back from the stage area. Additional police force was later called in, and mild force was used to bring the situation under control. Sunanda Sharma also appealed to the crowd from the stage to remain calm. After nearly 30 minutes, normalcy was restored, and the show resumed, continuing until midnight. Barricades collapsed due to overcrowding According to Circle Officer Sandeep Kumar, adequate security arrangements, including barricading, had been made to prevent fans from reaching the stage. However, the large crowd exerted pressure on the barricades, causing them to collapse. Police acted promptly to manage the situation, and the event concluded peacefully. Similar incident reported in Ghaziabad This is the second such incident involving Sunanda Sharma within days. On April 3, during a performance at Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology (RKGIT) in Ghaziabad, a fan suddenly climbed onto the stage mid-performance. The student, later identified as Shivang Pandey, attempted to touch the singer’s feet, which startled her and forced the show to be halted midway. He later apologized publicly, saying he acted out of admiration. Singer reacts, urges restraint Sunanda Sharma later shared a video on social media, stating that while she forgave the student, such incidents should be avoided. She expressed concern over safety, noting that unexpected actions can be frightening, especially given recent incidents involving performers. Ghaziabad incident: What happened on stage During the Ghaziabad event, the student managed to bypass security and jump onto the stage while the singer was performing. He rushed toward her and attempted to touch her feet, causing her to scream in fear. Security personnel quickly intervened, escorted the singer off stage, and detained the student. The show was subsequently canceled due to security concerns, leaving attendees disappointed.

stories.title: Lawyer shot by cousin in broad daylight at court:Presses wound with cloth, rushed to hospital on bike
stories.summary: A lawyer shot another lawyer in the chest inside the civil court premises in Lakhimpur Kheri on Monday. The victim collapsed on a wooden platform immediately after being hit, triggering panic. Eyewitnesses said the two had a heated scuffle before the firing. Although fellow lawyers intervened and separated them, the accused returned shortly after and openly fired. The incident took place around 12 noon on Monday, 6 April. The injured lawyer was admitted to the district hospital in a critical condition. The accused has been identified as Virat Raj, while the injured lawyer is Jitendra Raj. Both practise at the civil court and are cousins. After the attack, accused fled the spot. The incident is believed to be linked to a land dispute. See pictures.... What happened inside the court Virat Raj and Jitendra Raj, both practising lawyers at the civil court, got into an argument. The dispute escalated into a physical fight. Seeing the two lawyers fighting, other advocates intervened and separated them. The situation appeared to calm down and everyone returned to their work. However, shortly afterwards, Virat Raj returned. He approached Jitendra, pulled out a country-made pistol and fired. The bullet hit Jitendra in the chest, and he collapsed on the wooden platform. The sound of gunfire caused panic. Police soon reached the spot. With the help of police personnel, fellow lawyers rushed Jitendra to the hospital on a motorcycle. Doctors at the district hospital are treating him. Officials reach spot, probe underway On receiving information, District Magistrate Durga Shakti Nagpal and Superintendent of Police Dr Khyati Garg reached the spot immediately. According to police, initial investigation suggests that the two lawyers had an old dispute over a farmland boundary, which led to the incident. A search is underway to trace the accused.

stories.title: Girl molested in Gorakhpur, clothes torn:Father son assault her for resisting; mother alleges repeated obscene acts by accused
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, a girl was molested, and her clothes were torn. When her mother complained, the accused father and son together attacked and beat the woman and her daughter. The woman filed a complaint at Kotwali police station. Based on this, a case has been registered under serious sections against Nikhil Jaiswal, a resident of Miya Bazar North Gate, and his father, Akhilesh Jaiswal. Police are investigating the matter. Because of this, the daughter was not leaving the house. On Sunday, the woman took her daughter to Nikhil Jaiswal's house, and there, she informed his father, Akhilesh Jaiswal, about her son's misdeeds. The woman said that their son Nikhil harasses her daughter every day, which is why she is unable to go out. Father and son beat them together Hearing this, Akhilesh Jaiswal got angry at the woman and started verbally abusing her. Just then, his son Nikhil also arrived. Both of them attacked the woman and her daughter with kicks and punches. Nikhil grabbed the daughter by her hair, threw her down, and tore her clothes. Hearing the screams of the woman and her daughter, nearby people gathered and intervened. During this, Akhilesh and Nikhil threatened to kill them and chased the woman out of the house. After the incident, the woman and her family are completely terrified. The woman alleged that these people might commit a bigger incident in the future. A case has been registered at Kotwali police station on the complaint of the woman. The investigation of the matter has been handed over to Sub-Inspector Akash Singh. Station in-charge Chhatrapal Singh said, ‘A case has been registered, and the investigation is ongoing.’

stories.title: Married woman dies under suspicious circumstances in Agra:Father alleges dowry murder; says son-in-law demanded ₹4 lakh
stories.summary: In Mori village, under Kiraoli police station in Agra, a married woman named Rekha died under suspicious circumstances. The deceased's father, Mangelal, has accused her in-laws of strangling her to death because their additional dowry demands were not met. Rekha was married to Narendra alias Sonu in the year 2019. Rekha was being harassed since the marriage, due to which the matter reached the family counseling center. An agreement was reached between both parties at the family counseling center on November 27, 2025. In this, the husband had promised to live separately from Rekha and not to bother her. However, according to father Mangelal, on April 4, his son-in-law demanded 4 lakh rupees from him and also threatened to kill him. The next day, on April 5, Mangelal found the house locked and later received information about Rekha's death. After this incident, Rekha's two children, 5-year-old Naman and 2-year-old Namansi, have been orphaned. ACP Achhnera Shailendra Singh stated that The body has been sent for post-mortem. Police have started an investigation based on the complaint, and strict action will be taken against the culprits after the post-mortem report is received.

stories.summary: Inspector Satyendra Singh Malik from Bijnor has been suspended for accepting a fake explanation in connection with suspected terrorist Aaqib Khan, a resident of Meerut currently living in Dubai. Circle Officer Nitesh Pratap Singh has also been removed from the case and attached to the police lines. The controversy began six months ago after a video of Majul, a resident of Bijnor, went viral. He was seen speaking to Aaqib over an Instagram video call, during which what appeared to be an AK-47 rifle and a hand grenade were visible. The probe was assigned to the then-station in charge, Satyendra Singh Malik, who contacted both Majul and Aaqib. During questioning, Aaqib claimed the AK-47 was a toy, and the grenade was a perfume bottle. The officer accepted his explanation and submitted a final report giving both Aaqib and Majul a clean chit. The Circle Officer also failed to verify the claims independently. The lapse came to light after the Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorism Squad (UP ATS) arrested four suspected terrorists from Lucknow on April 2. During interrogation, the accused Saqib revealed his links with Dubai-based Aaqib. Following this disclosure, SP Abhishek Jha ordered action against the two officers on Sunday. See pictures How the case unfolded step by step 1. Viral video connection Majul, who runs a salon in South Africa, appeared in a video call last November with four individuals, including Aaqib. Weapons resembling an AK-47 and a grenade were visible during the conversation. The clip went viral on social media. 2. FIR registered On November 23, 2025, a case was registered at the Najibabad police station against Majul, Aaqib, and unidentified persons. The investigation was assigned to Inspector Satyendra Singh Malik, who later spoke to Aaqib through Majul. 3. Clean chit given Aaqib convinced the officer that the rifle was a toy and the grenade a perfume bottle. The explanation was accepted, and a final report clearing both accused was submitted without further verification. Arrested suspect reveals Pakistan link On April 2, UP ATS arrested Saqib alias Devil, Vikas Gehlawat alias Raunak, Lokesh alias Babu alias Papla Pandit, and Arbab from Lucknow. Authorities recovered a chemical-filled can, seven mobile phones, 24 pamphlets, and Aadhaar cards from them. During interrogation, Saqib, allegedly the gang leader, revealed that Aaqib had connected him with Pakistani handler Abu Bakar. This disclosure exposed serious lapses in the earlier investigation. Aaqib issues clarification from Dubai Two days earlier, Aaqib released a video on his Instagram profile from Dubai claiming he was being falsely implicated and had no links with any terrorist organisation. He said he has been working as a driver in Dubai for the past three years. Plot to target multiple cities uncovered ATS has taken the four arrested suspects on remand. Interrogation revealed a plan to carry out explosions in several cities after Lucknow. Pakistani handlers allegedly instructed them to leave the state after executing attacks. Investigators also recovered multiple audio clips from the suspects’ phones. These recordings contained detailed movement plans before the blasts and instructions to send videos after the explosions. Pakistani handlers reportedly used social media not only for calls but also to send audio guidance on reconnaissance, targets, and attack methods.

stories.title: 2 tempo travellers overturn within 1 hour in Nainital:18 tourists from Ghaziabad and Delhi injured
stories.summary: Two Tempo Traveller vehicles carrying tourists from Ghaziabad and Delhi to Nainital overturned at different locations within about 100 meters of each other on the Kaladhungi–Nainital road on Sunday, within an hour. A total of 18 tourists were injured in the two accidents, six of them seriously. In the first accident, a Tempo Traveller carrying 11 tourists from Delhi, reportedly employees of the same company, lost control on a sharp bend and overturned. All were injured, and the seriously injured were referred to Sushila Tiwari Hospital in Haldwani. About an hour later, another Tempo Traveller carrying 17 people, including the driver, from Ghaziabad, overturned on a bend on the same road after losing control. Seven passengers were injured and are undergoing treatment. Kaladhungi Kotwal Arun Kumar said both accidents occurred due to a sudden loss of vehicle control. Pictures after the accident Full details of accidents First accident: Vehicle overturned near Priya Bend The first accident occurred on the Kaladhungi-Nainital road, about 2 kilometers below Priya Bend, towards Kaladhungi. A Tempo Traveller carrying employees of Chamunda Petrochemicals Private Limited from Delhi suddenly lost control and overturned on the road. At the time of the accident, 11 people, including the driver and a small child, were in the vehicle. As soon as the vehicle overturned, screams erupted at the scene, and people nearby immediately rushed to help. 11 people injured, 5 in serious condition A total of 11 employees of the Chamunda Petrochemicals company were injured in the Tempo Traveller accident. These include Rajiv (40), Pooja Nagpal (40), Vinay Mishra (50), Vimal Kumar (24), Ashwani Kumar (42), Minakshi (27), Christina (3), Anuj (45), Rinku (25), Utkarsh Yadav (25), and Kamesh Kumar (27). Among them, Rajiv, Pooja Nagpal, Meenakshi, Anuj, and Utkarsh Yadav, due to their serious condition, were referred to Sushila Tiwari Hospital, Haldwani, after first aid, while the other injured were treated at Kaladhungi Community Health Center. Second accident: This also happened near Priya Band Ghaziabad's vehicle overturned 2 km ahead of Priya Band The second accident also happened about 2 kilometers ahead of Priya Band. Here, about 35 tourists from Modinagar (Ghaziabad) had come in two Tempo Travellers to visit Bhimtal and Nainital. One of these vehicles (HR 55AQ 0502) lost control and overturned on the road. This vehicle was being driven by Sandeep, son of Jogendra, a resident of Sonipat (Haryana), and it had 17 occupants, including the driver. 7 tourists from Ghaziabad injured, one in critical condition 7 people were injured when the Tempo Traveller carrying tourists who had come with their families from Modinagar (Ghaziabad) overturned. These include Krishna (15), Rishika (25), Uma (60), Pooja (40), Devendra Kumar Gupta (60), Girish alias Kailash (37), and Satish Kumar (50). Girish alias Kailash sustained serious injuries in the accident and was sent to Sushila Tiwari Hospital, Haldwani, after first aid, while other injured persons sustained minor injuries and were treated at Kaladhungi Community Health Center. Sharp turn and negligence became the cause of accidents This part of the Kaladhungi-Nainital road is already considered sensitive due to its sharp turn. According to local villagers, vehicles have overturned uncontrollably many times at this spot before, but despite this, no permanent safety arrangements have been made here. On Sunday, both accidents occurred in the same area, some distance apart, making it clear that this turn is continuously becoming a hub for accidents. Villagers say that there are neither adequate warning signs nor effective speed control arrangements on this road, due to which drivers coming from outside often fail to understand the situation. Villagers rescued, police-ambulance managed the situation Immediately after the first accident, local people were the first to reach the spot and started pulling out the injured. Many people were seen attending to the injured tourists on their own and moving them to a safe place. Upon receiving information, the police and 108 ambulance team reached the spot. After this, rescue operations were intensified, and the injured were transported to the hospital in sequence. The police also informed the families of the injured and managed the situation by controlling the crowd at the spot. Treatment amidst crying child and rush to the hospital After both accidents, when the injured were brought to the hospital, a chaotic atmosphere prevailed there for some time. As soon as the ambulance arrived, policemen and hospital staff were seen rapidly taking the injured to the emergency ward. During this time, several emotional scenes also emerged. A wounded woman was being taken in a wheelchair, while a little girl was seen crying after seeing her mother in an injured state. Panic was clearly visible on the faces of the people present in the hospital premises, while the team of doctors continuously remained engaged in treating the injured.

stories.title: Meerut woman celebrates divorce on road with fanfare:She says, 'I endured a lot of pain'; retired judge father calls split a new beginning
stories.summary: I struggled a lot mentally. I even faced anxiety and depression, but today I am here because my family supported me. My parents chose my happiness over society. Every girl should get such support. A girl should not be married until she is self-reliant. These words were spoken by Pranita Sharma of Meerut after her divorce on Monday. Her father, a retired judge, welcomed her back home with the same celebration as her wedding farewell, playing drums, dancing, distributing sweets, and greeting her with flowers and garlands, to send a message that a daughter remains part of her family even after marriage. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to Pranita and her family in this special report. First, see these three pictures Know the whole matter Finance Director at Judicial Academy In Meerut, Pranita Sharma works as Finance Director at Pranava Vashishtha Judicial Academy in Shastri Nagar and holds a post-graduation degree in Psychology. She was married on December 14, 2018, to Gaurav Agnihotri of Shahjahanpur, who is currently posted in Jalandhar. Her father, retired judge Gyanendra Sharma, said her in-laws’ behavior had been problematic since the marriage. Over the past seven years, Pranita allegedly faced repeated harassment from her husband and his family, and the situation did not improve even after the birth of their child. One-year-old son with Pranita She was mentally, physically, and emotionally harassed by her in-laws. Due to this, Pranita finally decided to get a divorce. An application was filed in the Meerut Family Court. On April 4, the court granted the divorce. After this, the family brought their daughter, Pranita Sharma, back home with full respect. Pranita and Gaurav have a one-year-old son, who is now with Pranita. Conversation with Pranita and her family Family's support is my strength Pranita said, The way I was welcomed after the divorce was a surprise for me. I didn't know that the family had planned so much. It felt very good to see that the family stands so strongly with their children. I struggled a lot mentally. I faced anxiety and depression, but today I am here because my family supported me. If mental health is not good, a person cannot do anything right. Parents chose my happiness Pranita said, my parents chose my happiness, not society. Even today, in many places, girls are told to 'go back to their in-laws' house', but my family chose me. Every girl should get such support. In my house, I was never called a 'daughter', but a 'young son'. That taught me that I am no less than anyone. Self-love and mental health are important Pranita is currently in her final semester of LLB. Pranita gave the message that it is important to be self-reliant. A girl should not be married until she is self-sufficient. Self-love and mental health are most important. Father said - not a legal battle, chose daughter's future Pranita's father, Gyanendra Sharma, has been associated with judicial services. He has written about 5 books. Gyanendra Sharma said that he deliberately did not choose any legal battles like alimony, maintenance, or property rights. He said, 'I know the judicial process. If we had taken the legal route, it could have taken 5-10 years or even more. I had to get my daughter out of that environment immediately. For me, money is not as important as my daughter's life. Gyanendra Sharma says that the court process increases mental stress. I wanted her to study, progress, and stand on her own feet. She will achieve the rest herself. What will people say is the biggest disease Pranita Sharma’s father, retired judge Gyanendra Sharma, questioned society’s mindset, saying the biggest problem is worrying about “what will people say.” He stressed that decisions should be based on a child’s happiness, not social pressure, and added that all major decisions in the family were taken together. He said divorce is not an end but a new beginning, just like a new innings starts after retirement. Concept of ‘pre-marriage training’ Gyanendra Sharma also shared the idea of mandatory “pre-marriage training,” saying his research shows nearly 70% of marital disputes can be prevented through proper counseling. He believes such training could eliminate many future problems. Pranita's mother said that daughter's happiness is paramount Pranita's mother, Madhavi Sharma, is a housewife. She says we prioritised our daughter's happiness over court proceedings. She said we thought it was better to give our daughter a new life than to fight a case. Now she is focusing on her studies and future. She said that her greatest happiness is that her daughter is safe and happy. We want her to move forward and be happy. This is everything to us. Spoke for her son-in-law, may he also be happy Pranita's mother Madhavi says, May she move forward, and may he (son-in-law) also move forward. May he be happy. It's not that we are saying anything wrong about him. He was also connected to us before. Our happiness knows no bounds, I thank God very much that my child is with me.

stories.title: UP farmers devastated after rain destroys crops:Sit in fields holding their heads; say ‘How will we repay our loans now?’
stories.summary: Strong winds and rain have damaged wheat and mustard crops across 43 cities in Uttar Pradesh, with hail reported in Kanpur, Lalitpur, Jhansi, and Jalaun. The worst impact was seen in Kanpur and Unnao, where hundreds of bighas of wheat crop were destroyed. Farmers who reached their fields were left distressed, sitting with their heads in their hands. They say, Due to waterlogging in the field, the potatoes turned black. We took them to the market, but they didn't sell even for a pittance. Don't know why God is angry. Strong winds flattened wheat crops and soaked the ears in water, while heavy hail in Lalitpur, Jhansi, and Jalaun covered roads and fields like a blanket, damaging nearly 50% of wheat and mustard crops in these districts. According to Atul Singh of the Regional Science Centre Lucknow, another Western Disturbance will become active on April 7 and affect the region until April 9, bringing more rain, strong winds, and possible hail. Weather conditions are expected to normalise from April 10. Dainik Bhaskar reported farmers’ ground situation from five cities. In Bidhnu area of Kanpur, farmer Ajay Singh says, This time the wheat crop was very good. The crop was ripe, and the harvesting contract had also been given. Laborers were supposed to start working in the field on Monday. On Saturday evening, it rained and hailed. The standing crop was flattened on the ground. Farmer Dhirendra Kumar says, I got my daughter married by taking a loan. I had to repay the loan by selling this wheat crop, but the crop is ruined, now I don't understand how I will repay the loan. We found him sitting in the field, holding his head. Farmers said that when hail fell, they fled, leaving the crops Hail fell along with rain in Madhogarh and Konch tehsils of Jalaun. Due to this, wheat, mustard, and gram crops in more than 50 villages fell to the ground. A white sheet of hail covered the ground. Farmer Ravindra Yadav says, When we were harvesting wheat, hail started falling, and they were large ones. We had to leave everything and run. Now look, the entire field is waterlogged. Wheat is kept in the field to dry, now if it rains again, nothing will be left. The pea crop had already been damaged in the previous rain. Back then, I had been patient, but now nothing makes sense. Farmer Chandrashekhar says, Earlier, I had borrowed money for fertilizer and seeds. Wheat was sown in 10 bigha and peas in 40 bigha. The rain and hailstones destroyed everything. Now, DM sir, if you could provide some help, we would get relief and be able to repay the loan. Fields waterlogged, harvested crop damaged Rain accompanied by hailstones damaged wheat crops across Bisawar and 20 nearby villages in the Sadabad area of Hathras, destroying more than 600 bighas of crop. Harvesting was already underway, and in many fields the cut wheat lying on the ground is now waterlogged after the hailstorm. Farmer Narayan Singh said, I had harvested wheat crop in 5.5 bighas of land, which was completely destroyed in the rain and hailstorm. I had cultivated this crop on a share basis, now there seems to be no way to compensate for the loss. Farmer Chaudhary Manoj Pansari of Nagla Dhati said, “My approximately 11.5 bigha crop was destroyed in the rain and hailstorm. All the harvested wheat crop was lying there. Another farmer, Chaudhary Manoj Pansari of Nagla Chhati, Sadabad, said, My 11 bigha crop has been destroyed in this hailstorm and rain. The rain has dashed the hopes of farmers. The harvested wheat crop lying in the field is completely soaked. Storm damages crops across Fatehpur Heavy rain with strong winds in Fatehpur damaged wheat and mustard crops. About 40% of the crop in the district had already been harvested, while the remaining 60% standing in fields fell due to the storm and rain. Around 150 bighas of crops were destroyed. Farmer Bhola said: Due to the rain, the ripe wheat crop in the field has been completely ruined, the gram crop has been completely destroyed and potatoes have turned black. We took them to the market, but they are not selling. In the Ong, Chaudagra, and Malwa areas of Malwa development block, crops including wheat, gram, potato, kundru (ivy gourd), lobia (black-eyed peas), and garlic were damaged. Recently sown urad (black gram) and moong (green gram) were also affected, while strong winds flattened standing wheat crops. Ratipal, a farmer from Dariyapur village, said, The wheat crop has fallen, and vegetables planted in the Ganga floodplains have also been destroyed. Prithvi Pal Nishad said: Along with moong and urad, the wheat crop has also been damaged. The fallen crop has started to turn black. 200 trees uprooted in Kanpur, road blocked even after 24 hours Heavy rain and storms in the city shook the roots of more than 200 trees. The situation was such that more than 100 electricity poles were uprooted. Even after 24 hours, power supply to half the city remained disrupted. Roads were blocked at various places. Traffic was managed by stopping and moving. How will the weather be in UP for the next 7 days? Read what Atul Singh, meteorologist at Lucknow's Regional Science Center, has to say This week’s weather forecast in UP The Western Disturbance active last week, affected the state until Sunday. Weather remains clear on Monday, but another Western Disturbance becomes active from Tuesday and continues till Thursday, bringing rain with strong winds across UP and possible hail at some places. From Friday, April 10, the weather will start normalising, and the heat will increase. Heat outlook after April 10 Areas receiving more rainfall may see a sudden temperature rise after April 10. Rain typically lowers temperatures by 5–7°C, and once skies clear, temperatures are expected to rise by a similar margin. No new Western Disturbance is expected afterward, so conditions will remain clear and heat will steadily increase. Eastern vs Western UP weather pattern

stories.title: 'We would have eliminated the HPCL officers’ killer ourselves':Suspended cop in Badaun questions alleged political protection to accused
stories.summary: ‘After such a brutal murder, the accused, Ajay Pratap Singh, should have faced a full encounter. We would have done it, what relation do we have with him?’ This statement was made by a police officer involved in the investigation of the killing of two officers at an Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) plant in Badaun. On March 12, 2026, Ajay Pratap Singh entered the HPCL plant in Sajni village and shot dead DGM Sudhir Kumar Gupta and AGM Harshit Mishra. He was later arrested after police shot him in both legs. The incident exposed alleged police negligence, and claims also surfaced that the accused had protection from an MLA. To find this out, the Dainik Bhaskar team reached Badaun. Read the full investigation Our team met with suspended Inspector Ajay Kumar and SI Dharmendra Kumar Singh. SI Dharmendra said - an FIR was registered against Ajay 2 months ago, but he was not arrested. If he had been arrested, he would not have committed 2 murders. Reporter: An FIR was filed against the accused Ajay Pratap Singh earlier. Why was he not arrested? SI Dharmendra Kumar Singh: Yes, the FIR was registered on February 4, 2026, but the investigation was still pending within the legal time frame. There was no section applicable for immediate arrest. Reporter: You are being accused of negligence for not arresting him and not filing the chargesheet on time? SI Dharmendra: There is a legal period of one month to file a chargesheet and up to 60 days for arrest. The investigation had not been completed yet, so it was not negligence. Reporter: Were you investigating the case personally? SI Dharmendra: Yes, and the investigation was still ongoing. Reporter: Then why couldn’t the police catch him earlier? SI Dharmendra: We conducted raids several times, but he was rarely found in the village. His family is not socially active. There was no pressure from the police level. Reporter: Could preventive action like Section 151 have stopped him? SI Dharmendra: If he had been caught earlier, we would have taken action under Section 151. A person with a criminal mindset cannot always be stopped at every level. Reporter: Some people say it should have been a full encounter, not a partial one? SI Dharmendra: After such a brutal crime, a full encounter would have been justified. If we had been given that freedom, we would have done it ourselves. We have no personal relationship with the accused. Reporter: Is the accused influential? SI Dharmendra: He appears to be influential, though I cannot disclose internal matters. After this, we reached Dataganj block. Here we met Block Development Officer (BDO) Virendra Ram. Conversation with Dataganj BDO in Dataganj Reporter: Did the accused Ajay Pratap Singh’s wife receive a government house? BDO Virendra Ram: Yes, she received a house. Reporter: If she was ineligible, how was it allotted? BDO Virendra Ram: I don’t know. The allotment happened in 2024–25 before my tenure. Reporter: Do such decisions happen under pressure? BDO Virendra Ram: We just have to bear such situations. If the accused had been killed in an encounter, the controversy would have cooled down sooner. ‘Khadi and Khaki protected the murder accused’ The team also met former Bharatiya Janata Party MP Dharmendra Kashyap from Aonla in Bareilly, where Sajni village of murder accused Ajay Pratap Singh falls. Kashyap alleged that the accused received protection from a local MLA and his Block Pramukh son, and claimed a suspended sub-inspector in the case was seen openly moving in a car with the accused, even while officials were pleading for their lives, raising serious questions about justice. He further said most people working around the Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited plant belong to the same caste, deepening concerns of bias, and alleged the accused had local political patronage, leading to weak action. Kashyap questioned how a single person entered the company premises, killed two officers, and then surrendered at a police station, asking whose car he used and who accompanied him. He demanded an impartial probe, criticised the SSP’s response as unsatisfactory, and alleged the “half encounter” was carried out under pressure from local leaders. 3 things came to light in our investigation MLA said - We have no connection with accused Ajay In this matter, we spoke to BJP MLA Rajiv Pratap Singh alias Babbu Bhaiya from Dataganj. He said, The police are investigating this matter. We have no connection with accused Ajay. When asked if there were several photos of accused Ajay with his Block Pramukh son, he hung up the phone without answering.

stories.title: New evidence twists Kanpur kidney racket probe:Dr Afzal seen relaxing on bundles of cash; videos seized from broker’s phone
stories.summary: Fresh evidence has surfaced in the alleged kidney transplant racket in Kanpur. Three new videos and several chats have been recovered from the mobile phone of broker Shivam Agarwal in the Kanpur kidney transplant case. First video: Doctor Afzal, accused of extracting kidneys, is seen lying on stacks of currency notes, with around Rs 15 lakh spread across a bed like a sheet. Second video: A South African patient, Arabica, is seen crying after undergoing a kidney transplant at Ahuja Hospital. Ambulance driver Shivam Agarwal is seen checking her with a stethoscope and saying she needs to be given an injection. Third video: A patient from Punjab is seen outside Ahuja Hospital, alleging he paid Rs 43 lakh for a kidney transplant and says he is now left with no option but suicide. Read the full report Broker seen examining Arabica as a doctor Arabica, a woman from South Africa, underwent a kidney transplant at Ahuja Hospital in December 2025. In a newly surfaced video from the Kanpur kidney transplant case, she is seen continuously crying, with tears rolling down her face after the surgery. In the video, ambulance driver Shivam Agarwal is seen examining her with a stethoscope and asking if she is okay. Arabica nods “yes” but says she is experiencing pain in her lower back. Shivam responds that she will need to be given an injection and again asks about her overall condition, to which she nods while crying and says she is fine. Shivam Agarwal, alias Shivam Kada, is accused of acting as a key broker in the racket, primarily responsible for arranging patients. However, he had reportedly become so influential at the hospital that he even reached patients inside the operating theatre and examined them himself. The deal for Arabica’s kidney transplant is said to be worth Rs 2 to Rs 2.5 crore. DCP West S.M. Qasim Abidi said, Police teams are continuously working to reach Arabica. Investigations are underway into how many people came to India from South Africa or other places under the guise of kidney treatment. Dr Afzal seen lying on stacks of notes Paid 43 lakh rupees, but didn't get a kidney Racket linked to Nepal, kidneys bought and sold across border During the investigation into the kidney transplant racket, police recovered a video of a Nepali youth whose kidney had been transplanted. Evidence also shows another kidney was purchased from a Nepali youth for about Rs 10 lakh. A police team has been sent to Nepal to trace both youths, which is expected to reveal who facilitated the kidney sale and who arranged the transplant. DCP West SM Qasim Abidi said one youth, identified as Raj Shumbha in preliminary findings, was allegedly trapped through Telegram and his kidney was reportedly dealt for about Rs 9 lakh. 6 more linked to Medilife Hospital to be sent to jail So far, police have identified 15 people connected to the kidney transplant network. Nine have already been jailed, while six more suspects linked to Medilife Hospital in Kalyanpur are currently being interrogated. Though their names have not been disclosed, they have provided key information in the case, and police are preparing to send them to jail as well. Clues found from Shivam Kada's mobile Kanpur police exposed the illegal kidney transplant happening at Ahuja Hospital in Kalyanpur on March 31. Along with the doctor couple Preeti Ahuja and Surjeet Ahuja, 9 accused were arrested and sent to jail. DCP West SM Asim Kabidi is leading the investigation into the kidney scandal. More than 12 police teams are raiding Kanpur, Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Uttarakhand, MP, and Nepal in search of the accused. DCP West said, 3 important videos have come to light during the investigation. The video of the broker Shivam Agarwal alias Shivam Kada, who was sent to jail, has surprised the police. Shivam Kana himself is checking the South African girl Arabica, who is undergoing a kidney transplant, with a stethoscope and asking about her condition. DCP West further said that CCTV footage of people coming and going from Ahuja Hospital on the night of March 29 was scanned. Two cars were transporting the doctors. 5 doctors were seen leaving in one car and 3 in the other. 3 doctors were dropped in Ghaziabad, while 5 doctors were dropped in Lucknow. So far, the investigation has revealed that this gang includes Dr. Rohit alias Rahul from Noida, and 3 doctors from Meerut: Dr Afzal, Dr Vaibhav, and Dr Anurag alias Amit. All their names are also in the FIR. Police are raiding to arrest all these doctors.

stories.title: Storm rain alert issued in 18 districts of UP:Weather to worsen further for next 3 days from tomorrow
stories.summary: Unseasonal rain has changed the weather across Uttar Pradesh, with chilly winds bringing a drop in temperatures on Monday morning in several districts, including Lucknow and Kanpur. The sun remained weak, and a rain alert with thunder and lightning has been issued for 18 districts today, along with the possibility of storms and hail. The Meteorological Department said temperatures across the state have fallen by up to 4°C in the last 48 hours, with the maximum dropping from 42°C to 38°C. Weather is expected to remain clear in western UP today, while eastern UP may see scattered showers. From tomorrow until April 9, rain and hail are likely across the state. Rain and hail in several districts On Sunday, rain was reported in 10 districts, including Varanasi (Kashi) and Kanpur, while hail fell in five districts, including Mathura and Sambhal. In Jalaun, hail fell twice within 24 hours, covering roads and fields with ice and damaging wheat and mustard crops. Etawah recorded the highest rainfall at 30 mm, while Bahraich remained the hottest at 38.2°C. Meanwhile, 15 people have died in the last four days due to storms, rain, and lightning across the state, including four deaths in Kanpur, three in Sitapur, and two each in Varanasi, Chitrakoot, Siddharthnagar, and Lalitpur. Lucknow's meteorologist, Atul Singh, said- A new Western Disturbance is becoming active from April 7. This will bring heavy rain with storms across the entire state. Hail may also fall. Wind speed will reach up to 60 km/h. Temperatures will drop by 3 to 5 degrees. The weather will remain like this until April 9. Weather for the next 3 days Weather pictures

stories.title: BJP names Yogi, Hema Malini, Smriti Irani as star campaigners:PM Modi Rajnath Singh also included in Bengal campaign list
stories.summary: The BJP released its first list of star campaigners for the West Bengal Assembly elections on Sunday night. It includes Prime Minister Narendra Modi from UP, Defense Minister Rajnath Singh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, and Mathura MP Hema Malini as star campaigners. Former Amethi MP Smriti Irani has also been made a star campaigner. CM Yogi Adityanath's election rallies will begin from next week for the West Bengal Assembly elections. CM Yogi will hold 8 to 10 rallies. Know when are the Assembly elections in West Bengal The West Bengal Assembly elections will be held in 2 phases. The first phase of voting will be on April 23 and the second phase on April 29. Counting of votes will take place on May 4. The term of the 294-seat West Bengal Assembly is ending on May 7, 2026. Know who will campaign in Bengal The list of star campaigners released by BJP includes senior leaders like PM Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, Defense Minister Rajnath Singh, JP Nadda, Nitin Gadkari, Dharmendra Pradhan, Fadnavis, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, Yogi Adityanath, Himanta Biswa Sarma, Ashwini Vaishnaw, Smriti Irani, Anurag Thakur, Bhupendra Yadav, Arjun Munda, Babulal Marandi and Biplab Kumar Deb. Apart from these, Mithun Chakraborty, Kangana Ranaut, Hema Malini, Manoj Tiwari, Leander Paes, Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, Sukanta Majumdar, Shantanu Thakur, Amit Malviya and several other central and state level leaders will also campaign in Bengal. PM Modi started from Cooch Behar PM Modi addressed a public rally in Cooch Behar, West Bengal on Sunday. He said - Our Bengal is the land of 'Shakti Puja'. I would like to tell all the sisters and daughters who have come here, every sister and daughter of Bengal, that BJP is in the field for your respect and your prosperity. If BJP comes to power, it will open the path for true empowerment of women and this is our track record. After May 4, the law will do its work. No matter how influential the criminal may be, this time justice will prevail. For many years, the hard-earned money of the people of Bengal has been looted. Every corrupt person will be held accountable and will have to return the looted property to the public. Now know the BJP's mathematics in Bengal Modi-Yogi had delivered a big victory in Bihar elections In the Bihar elections held 5 months ago, NDA achieved a resounding victory with 202 seats. BJP alone won 89 seats. Prime Minister Narendra Modi secured 97 seats for NDA through 16 rallies. This included 44 new seats. PM's strike rate was 80%. Similarly, CM Yogi also helped win 98 seats with an 80% strike rate. In Bihar, there was maximum demand for CM Yogi's rallies, meetings and road shows. Even big leaders of Bihar wanted to organize Yogi's rallies in their assembly constituencies. It is said that due to Yogi's firebrand Hindutva and Bulldozer Baba image, there is more demand for his rallies. Apart from this he has a strict Chief Minister image regarding law and order. Crime was controlled in UP due to encounters and bulldozers. Therefore, Yogi's image is better in neighboring districts. Political analysts also believe that Yogi's speeches help BJP to consolidate and unite their saffron vote bank. Not much effort is required to gather crowds at CM Yogi's rallies. That's why there is maximum demand for CM Yogi's rallies.

stories.title: Landslide in Sikkim traps 1500 tourists:15 die in UP within 72 hours due to lightning; thunderstorm alert in 16 states
stories.summary: Heavy rain and snowfall occurred in Sikkim's Mangan district on Sunday. This caused a landslide and led to 1500 tourists being trapped in the area of the Lachen-Chungthang road. The authorities have initiated a rescue operation for the trapped tourists. A major change has been observed in the weather of North India due to the impact of the Western Disturbances. On Sunday, snowfall occurred in three districts of Uttarakhand, including Yamunotri Dham. Meanwhile, hail storm was witnessed along with rain in 6 other districts. Additionally, snowfall has also occurred in the higher reaches of Lahaul and Spiti in Himachal Pradesh. The snow table in various districts is as follows- 1. 28.5 cm of snow in Gondla 2. 20.0 cm in Keylong 3. Five centimeters of snow in Hasa and Kukumsairi. Moreover, key cities of Himachal, like Shimla, Kullu, and Mandi, after the hailstorm, witnessed damage to their apple production. UP reports death due to bad weather Meanwhile, in Uttar Pradesh, 15 people died in 72 hours due to storms, rain, and lightning. On Sunday, intermittent rain occurred in 11 districts, including Kashi, Gonda, Sultanpur, and Kanpur. Winds blew at a speed of 40-50 kilometers per hour. Meanwhile, hailstorms were reported in Kanpur, Mathura, Sambhal, Farrukhabad, and Hathras. Weather in Rajasthan A new weather system will become active in Rajasthan today. Due to its impact, there is an alert for heavy rain with storms in 13 districts. Meanwhile, there is a possibility of rain with hail in Delhi-NCR and some parts of Haryana on Sunday night. 3 pictures of rain-snowfall across the country

stories.title: VIDEO before boat capsized in Vrindavan:Devotees chanting ‘Radhe-Radhe’ and clapping; none were wearing life jackets
stories.summary: A video has emerged from Vrindavan, Mathura, taken 15 minutes before the boat capsized. This video was posted by the devotees in their Banke Bihari member WhatsApp group. All the tourists were clapping and chanting 'Radhe-Radhe'. Everyone looked very happy. There was a higher number of women on the boat. No one was wearing a life jacket. Actually, a private boat carrying 27 tourists from Punjab capsized in the Yamuna River on Friday, around 3 PM. 10 tourists have died by drowning. Among them are 7 women and 3 men. Currently, 5 people are missing and are being searched for. The young man who survived said - he had warned the boatman to slow down, but he didn't listen The young man who survived the accident said - About 25-27 people were cruising in a boat on the Yamuna river. Everyone was chanting. The boatman was driving the boat at high speed. We warned the boatman 2 to 3 times. We told him to drive the boat slowly. At that time, the wind was blowing strong, and our boat in the middle of the river collided with the pontoon bridge. The collision was so severe that the boat lost its balance and capsized in no time. We all fell into the water. There was a lot of screaming. We were asking for divers to be called. But no help came. The ambulance was also not arriving. After this, other boats present and local people came and started rescuing us. Our whole family and relatives were together. So far, many people have been safely rescued, but some people are still missing or in the hospital. The administration is responsible for the accident. We demand that the boatmen should be apprehended. The situation was very terrifying; we couldn't understand what happened in the blink of an eye. What other devotees said A group of 120 people came from Punjab: A woman said - A group of more than 120 people had come from Punjab. The boat capsized. Many people have drowned. Some people have been rescued. The boatman was asked to stop the boat: Tanish Jain of Jagraon, Ludhiana district, was also on board the boat that met with the accident. He said that about 130 people had come to visit Vrindavan by two buses. All are staying near Fogla Ashram in Vrindavan. Collision on the third attempt, diver rescued: He said that when our boat reached near the pontoon bridge, we told the boatman that the bridge was coming, stop it. But he did not stop. The boat narrowly avoided collision twice. On the third attempt, it collided. There were some divers nearby who rescued us. Now know how the accident happened On Friday afternoon at 2:30 PM, devotees set out on a boat to tour the Yamuna. The Pipa bridge is only 400 meters away from KC Ghat. At that time, the wind was also quite strong. At 2:45 PM, the boat started swaying due to the wind. Suddenly, it collided with the Pipa bridge. Then the boat completely submerged in the Yamuna. All the people on board the boat drowned. Divers present at the scene launched a rescue operation. After this, the police arrived at the scene. 10 people have died. 5 people are still missing. The boat has also not been found. The Army, NDRF, DM, SP, DIG are present at the scene. Locals said - boatmen seat people arbitrarily, Local Lala Pehalwan said - there have been many arguments with the administration and boatmen. We people say that they seat 25-25, 30-30 people in the boat. There is no rule, no life jacket. Anyway, whatever it is, the accident has become very big. Whatever work the administration is doing, we want to tell the administration that in the future, they will have to make a plan by consulting local people and the Teerth Purohit Brajwasi Panda Sabha. Outside boatmen have also come here. Aunts, nieces, uncles, paternal aunts... all of them are coming and operating boats, which is wrong. Overloading is the cause of the accident Overloading is the cause of the accident. And they say some rope got stuck in this bridge. Operating a boat means Yamuna Vihar, our Thakur ji had done Yamuna Vihar. So, operating a boat doesn't just mean roaming around, it doesn't mean playing songs. We request the administration to set a rule that there should not be more than 8 people, life jackets should be available, and a fixed fare should be charged. What happens is that they set a fare of 100-200 rupees, they feel like quickly taking them around and dropping them off to pick up new people. Small children and novice people are operating boats - Councilor Ghanshyam Chaudhary, a Congress councilor from Vrindavan, said - Overloading has been a major reason for the boat capsizing in the Yamuna Ji. We had warned the administration and the boatmen many times not to seat more people than the capacity in the boats, but no one paid attention. Absolutely not. Neither did anyone have a life jacket, nor any other means of rescue. Boat operators also do not follow the rules. Even small children and novice people are operating boats, who have no idea about the depth and current of the water. Our demand from the administration is that strict rules should be made for the operation of boats. Life jackets should be made mandatory, heavy fines should be imposed for overloading, and only experienced sailors should be licensed to prevent such accidents in the future.

stories.title: ‘Yaksh’ app sharpens smart policing:Reveals shocking truth in robbery and kidnapping, saves elderly man from false case
stories.summary: The 'Yaksha' app is providing significant help in police action against criminals in Uttar Pradesh. In just 90 days, more than a dozen serious cases have been solved. This app provided quick assistance to the police in cases like kidnapping, murder, robbery, and theft. It brought out surprising truths in robbery-kidnapping cases. It saved an elderly person from a false case. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had launched this app during the 'Police Manthan' program. Robbery solved in a few hours, a surprising truth in the kidnapping case According to DGP Rajiv Krishna, the Yaksha app includes a complete digital database of criminals, CCTV camera locations, and advanced analytical tools. Where earlier police had to search old registers, now the complete history comes up in minutes. The app made a big revelation in a kidnapping case in Hardoi. The investigation revealed that the person whose kidnapping was reported had been in jail for two and a half years. The robbery of a Jan Seva Kendra operator in Jaunpur on March 11, 2026, was solved within a few hours. Police scanned more than 40 CCTV footages, which helped identify and track the location of the accused. Subsequently, three criminals were arrested in an encounter, and about 1.30 lakh rupees were recovered. Two robbery incidents that occurred within an hour in Kakori, Lucknow, were solved within 48 hours. Police apprehended the accused by analysing their mobile locations and activities. With the help of the same app, an 8-member interstate vehicle theft gang was also busted in Raebareli. Elderly man saved from false accusation The Yaksh app has proven effective not only in catching criminals but also in saving innocent people. In Agra, an elderly man was falsely accused of molestation. Police identified the real culprits through CCTV footage and face recognition and arrested them. The app also played a crucial role in apprehending the murder accused in Bareilly. Similarly, in Meerut, Hathras, Farrukhabad, Kanpur, and Gonda, theft and pickpocketing gangs were exposed with their help. What are the features of the 'Yaksha' app?

stories.title: Woman climbs UP High Court roof with child:Says i will jump, claims no justice; wants divorce from husband
stories.summary: A woman climbed onto the roof of the Lucknow High Court with her child in her arms and threatened to jump. Shouting, she said - I did not get justice. This high-voltage drama continued for about an hour. However, some security personnel showed presence of mind and kept the woman engaged in conversation. As soon as her attention was diverted, a female constable pulled her down from the railing and secured her. This incident occurred on Friday evening around 4 PM at the five-story building located in C-Block of the High Court campus. The woman has been identified as Rupali Sharma, a resident of Gonda. Actually, her divorce case with her husband is ongoing. She had come for mediation for the third time. She had an argument with her husband in court over something, which made her angry. See the first 4 pictures Had a love marriage with a Muslim youth Roopali had a love marriage with Mohammad Sabir about two years ago. The marriage took place without the consent of both their families. After a few days of marriage, fights started between them. During this time, the woman became pregnant. Roopali filed an application for divorce in court. Initially, dates were given for settlement in the lower court. When no solution was found, the matter reached the High Court, where mediation was ongoing. The husband did not attend this. Every time a new date was given. Distressed by this, the woman took this step. CRPF security officer said - The woman was safely brought down with her child CRPF security officer R.K. Tiwari said- The team, acting with prudence, first engaged the woman in conversation and, seeing the right opportunity, safely brought her down. After a rescue operation that lasted about an hour, the woman and her child were safely rescued.

Clearance drive near Sambhal Jama Masjid:8 bigha encroachment to go; 18 houses and shops in graveyard to be demolished
stories.summary: The illegal construction built on the graveyard land adjacent to the Jama Masjid in Sambhal will be demolished. The Civil Court has dismissed its own stay on the administration's action. Now, after the final decision from the Tehsil Court, the administration will take action to remove the illegal construction. This entire dispute is regarding about 8 bighas of graveyard land in the Kotwali area. A complaint was received by the DM regarding this. It stated that stones were pelted at the survey team and police during the Sambhal violence from the roofs of the houses and shops built on this very graveyard land. The administration had measured the land on December 30, 2023. Against this, some people approached the Allahabad High Court, but did not get relief there. The matter was then sent back to the Tehsil Court. After the administration's notice, the encroachers filed a petition in the Civil Court, on which the court had issued a stay. 18 houses-shops are built on 8 bighas of graveyard land Now read the full story in detail Claim of being a graveyard before 1990 On December 12, 2025, Subhash Tyagi (Shri Kalki Sena), while filing a complaint with the District Magistrate, claimed that this entire land was a graveyard before 1990. Later, illegal construction took place on it. He claimed that stones were thrown at the police from the roofs of these illegal houses during the Sambhal violence. Following this, a team comprising the Tehsildar, Naib Tehsildar, and 26 Kanungo-Lekhpals was formed on the orders of the SDM. The land was measured on November 30, 2025. The administration sent notices to the illegal encroachers in this matter. Against this, the occupants filed a petition in the Allahabad High Court in January 2026. On this, the High Court dismissed the petition and advised them to go to the Tehsildar Court. 4 out of 15 encroachers withdrew their petition Out of 18, a total of 15 illegal encroachers, including Salma Rani wife of Shahabuddin, filed a petition in Sambhal Civil Court in January 2026. Three main defendants were named in this, including the Executive Officer of Nagar Palika Parishad Sambhal, the CEO of UP Sunni Central Waqf Board, and the DM and Tehsildar on behalf of the Government of Uttar Pradesh. Out of the 15, four later withdrew their petition. Civil Court Judge Lalit Kumar, on February 27, 2026, ordered to maintain the status quo by staying administrative action until the completion of the case hearing. On March 27, the government lawyers of the Nagar Palika received a copy of the court order. On March 9, DGC Prince Sharma appeared in court and received a copy of the petition. Thereafter, dates were set for March 9, March 16, March 23, March 30, and March 10. On March 16, no cross-examination could take place due to a strike. Lawyer said - Court removed the stay after the truth came out Nalin Jain, the lawyer for the Municipal Council, said - "The disputed site in Mohalla Kot Purvi, Sambhal, was a graveyard next to a religious place. Some people had occupied its land and obtained a stay from the Civil Court by misleading it. I filed a reply on behalf of the municipality and argued the case." Today, the court dismissed the stay after the truth came to light. Now, the stay imposed by the Civil Court on the land of the graveyard where illegal houses are built has been removed. Illegal encroachers had obtained a stay by misleading the court. After the facts were presented by the municipality, there is now no stay in any of the 11 cases that were taken on the cemetery.

stories.title: International cricket stadium to be built in Ghaziabad:Construction on 37 acres at cost of 400 crore; 380-acre aerocity township planned nearby
stories.summary: An International Cricket Stadium and Aerocity Township will be developed in Ghaziabad at an estimated cost of around 2200 crore rupees. This will be Western UP's first international cricket stadium, built across approximately 37 acres. An Aerocity will be established around it, spanning 380 acres. The Aerocity will feature shopping malls, high-tech business hubs, international convention centres, sports academies, and smart residential areas. Preparations are underway for Prime Minister Narendra Modi to lay the foundation stone for both projects. Development of sports, business, and tourism across 417 acres Nand Kishore Kalal, VC of Ghaziabad Development Authority, stated that the two proposed projects in Rajnagar Extension (Morti area) will create an integrated urban hub, where sports, business, tourism, and modern lifestyle will develop simultaneously. Actually, the blueprint for this project was prepared in 2014-15, but it could not progress for a long time. Due to the sluggishness of the previous government, this project remained stalled for years. Now, under the Yogi government, it is being given priority and rapidly moved forward. Stadium to have a seating capacity of 30,000 The Ghaziabad International Cricket Stadium, which will be built at an estimated cost of around 400 crore rupees, will have a capacity of more than 30,000 spectators. It will feature modern facilities such as a media centre and a high-tech lighting system. The construction of this stadium will provide Western Uttar Pradesh with its first opportunity to host major international cricket matches. To become a complete destination for work, living, and entertainment Nand Kishore Kalal, VC of Ghaziabad Development Authority, stated that the Aerocity developing around the stadium will be the biggest highlight of this entire project. It will include large hotels, luxury resorts, modern shopping malls, retail zones, high-tech business hubs, office spaces, and entertainment centres. Being close to the airport, this area will become a major attraction for tourists and investors from India and abroad. Both projects are being developed as a new urban model. It will also include a sports academy, smart residential complexes, green spaces, and outdoor sports facilities, making this area a complete destination for living, working, and entertainment. Employment from the hotel, retail, and service sectors After the proposal is passed by the Ghaziabad Development Authority (GDA) board, it will now be developed on a joint venture model with the UP Cricket Association. All facilities are being designed according to global standards, so that this project can become a major hub for investment and development in the future. Upon completion of this mega project, Ghaziabad and the entire Western Uttar Pradesh will receive significant economic benefits. Large-scale employment opportunities will be created, from construction to the hotel, retail, and service sectors.

stories.title: 10 dead after tourist boat capsizes on Yamuna river:Steamer with over 25 people onboard hits bridge in Mathura: 15 rescued, several missing
stories.summary: A steamer boat carrying around 30 people, including tourists and locals, overturned in the Yamuna River in Vrindavan, Mathura district, on Friday. Ten people have died due to drowning, officials confirmed. Mathura District Magistrate Chandra Prakash Singh confirmed that nine people lost their lives in the incident. More than 10 passengers are still reported missing, raising concerns that the death toll may increase. जनपद मथुरा में नाव पलटने से हुई दुर्घटना में जनहानि अत्यंत दुःखद एवं हृदय विदारक है।मेरी संवेदनाएं शोक संतप्त परिवारों के साथ हैं। संबंधित अधिकारियों को तत्काल मौके पर पहुंचकर बचाव व राहत कार्य संचालित करने और घायलों का समुचित उपचार कराने के निर्देश दिए हैं।प्रभु श्री राम…— Yogi Adityanath (@myogiadityanath) April 10, 2026 Rescue operations underway Police teams rushed to the spot immediately after receiving information about the accident. A rescue operation has been launched, and teams have already recovered one body from the river. The State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) has been called in to assist with the ongoing search and rescue efforts. #WATCH | Uttar Pradesh | A boat accident occured on the Yamuna River near Keshi Ghat in Mathura. According to the Police, 22 individuals have been rescued and shifted to hospitals, but investigation is underway to determine how many of them are safe. Further details awaited. pic.twitter.com/kwzlwF0Kkz— ANI (@ANI) April 10, 2026 Tourists from Punjab According to initial reports, all the passengers onboard the steamer were tourists from Punjab who had come to visit Vrindavan. Authorities are continuing efforts to locate the missing individuals as the rescue operation intensifies.

stories.title: Debt-hit youth sells kidney, falls into crime trap:Paid ₹3.5 lakh instead of promised ₹10 lakh, seeks justice
stories.summary: Everyone has compulsions, I also had a very big compulsion. There was no source of income. In 2020-21, I used to work in Delhi, but for some reason, I left the job. I had a debt of 3 lakh rupees. Because of this, I can't even go to my village. I thought I would get 10 lakh rupees after selling my kidney. With this money, I will repay the debt, and with the remaining money, I will start a business, and set up my life.' Ayush Kumar Chaudhary, a resident of Augan village in Bhagwanpur, Begusarai district, Bihar, said these things in a conversation with Dainik Bhaskar. Ayush said that I was referred from Kanpur to Lucknow, and now I am undergoing treatment in Delhi. Actually, news had come that Ayush had sold his kidney in Kanpur out of greed for money. But when we talked to the people of Ayush's village, a different story emerged. When asked about the reason for selling his kidney, Ayush answered the reporter's questions for 4 minutes. After that, he said that he would not be able to talk for long. He was in pain. The doctor has also forbidden excessive talking. The story I have, I am sending it recorded. Ayush shared a 14-minute audio, in which he narrated his entire story. First, see two pictures of Ayush Chaudhary Now, what did Ayush reveal in the 14-minute audio? Ayush Chaudhary said that after leaving his job, he became unemployed. During this time, one day while scrolling through social media on his mobile, he came across a Telegram group. It was stated that money would be received upon completing the task. When I inquired on the number given in the group, I found the number of a boy named Ali. I talked to him. Ali told me that I would have to give him my bank account on rent. For this, I would receive money. I had asked Ali what kind of task this was, and he told me that transactions would be made from my bank account to save taxes, etc. I needed money. So, I shared my Canara Bank account number and other details with Ali. Ali gave me 20 thousand rupees for this. Actually, before receiving 20 thousand rupees, 85 thousand rupees were transferred to my account. After receiving the money, one lakh rupees were sent to my account. After this, my account was frozen. 'When I went to the bank to inquire, I found out that cyber fraud had occurred with my account' Ayush said that when my account was frozen, I did not get any information about it. Ali called me and asked - why did you freeze your account? I told Ali that I don't know anything about this. Then I went to the bank and asked for information regarding the account freeze. The bank officials told me that a cyber fraud had occurred from my account, which is why my account had been frozen. I informed Ali about this. Ali said that it might have happened by mistake, don't worry. Ayush further stated that he needed money in March. I told Ali that if there was any work suitable for me, he should let me know. I had also said that this time, he shouldn't tell me about any work that could get me or others into trouble. The work should be such that there are no problems and I also get some money. After this, Ali told me about selling a kidney. When I questioned Ali about this, he said that everything would be done according to the law. Proper paperwork would be done, and then the whole process would take place. Ali told me about Alpha Hospital in Meerut. I inquired about the hospital. After that, I thought everything would be legal; I didn't know that police verification was required. Then, swayed by Ali's words, I considered it and agreed to sell my kidney. Ali called me to Meerut. When I got off at Modipuram Bypass, I was picked up by car and taken to Alpha Hospital. At Alpha Hospital, there were people named Vaibhav and Amit, who made me sit in an upstairs room of the hospital for a while, and then arranged a room for me in a hotel in Shastri Nagar, Meerut. 'Diagnostic and MRI were done in Ghaziabad' Ayush said that the day after reaching Meerut, I was taken to Ghaziabad, where diagnostic and MRI were done. From there, I was brought back to Meerut. The next day, two individuals named Afzal and Parvez came to meet me. A patient named Parul had come to them. Afzal and Parvez took me in a Swift Dzire. When I was being taken somewhere, I had sent the car's number to a close contact on WhatsApp. After that, I deleted all this from my mobile. I used to do all this so that there would be no problem later. I was brought from Meerut to Kanpur, where I was kept for two days. Two days later, on March 21st, it was Eid, and I was told that the kidney transplant would take some time. After this, I was brought back to Meerut and stayed in a hotel. Two days later, on March 23rd, I was again brought to Kanpur. I was in a separate car, along with two other cars, which had Afzal, Parvez, Ali, Dr. Amit, and Dr. Vaibhav. The next day, March 24th, these people talked about a kidney transplant in Shamli. According to Ayush, we were brought to Dev Hospital near Shamli Gurudwara. That same day, I saw patient Parul for the first time, who was in another car. I was lodged in a hotel here for three days. On March 27, I was asked to be ready. I needed 6 thousand rupees. Afzal gave 6 thousand rupees after 4 days. This made me suspicious that if these people were taking so long to give 5-6 thousand rupees, would I get the full amount after the kidney transplant or not? But I trusted them. In the evening, I was suddenly told that the kidney transplant would happen. Amit and Ali had stayed in Kanpur. I, along with Afzal and Parvez, reached Kanpur from Shamli. I had been told in the morning not to eat, so I had a light breakfast at 8 o'clock. Asked for mobile to check account, but wasn't given Ayush said that before the operation, when I asked about the payment, I was told not to worry. I was brought to Priya Hospital with Afzal and Parvez, where I met a boy named Shivam. The patient's brother, Divyank Tomar, was here. He also told me that I would get the money. After this, I was brought to Ahuja Hospital. Late in the evening, I was given anaesthesia, which made my eyes start closing. After the kidney was removed in the operation theater, I was brought back to the hospital at 2:30 AM. In the morning, I was troubled by pain. When I woke up, I asked for my mobile to check my account balance, but I was not given the mobile. In the evening, suddenly the police came to me and gave me my phone. They had me unlock the phone. The police asked me to check my account. I didn't understand where the police had come from. When I checked the account, 3.50 lakh rupees had been deposited. But after that, the remaining 6.50 lakh rupees have not been received to date. The policeman had said at that time that he would get all the money for me, but it has not been received to date. Ayush said - Police had given assurance, but now they don't answer calls Ayush said that I told the police at that very moment that I did this work out of compulsion, then the police had said that they would get the money back, but now even the police don't answer my calls. My clothes, ATM, and bag have not been returned to me till date. There was some improvement on March 30, but I had a mild stomach ache, then I started getting a fever, so I was referred to Lucknow. I was discharged from the Lucknow hospital on April 6. Then I called the police again and told them the whole story. I had sold my kidney out of compulsion, I was saving someone's life in exchange for money, but what a mess I got into. I didn't get the money, and my kidney was also gone. We are troubled. I was offered 10 lakh for the kidney. Gujarat Cyber Police notice against Ayush SHO Neeraj Kumar Thakur of Bhagwanpur police station told a Dainik Bhaskar reporter four days ago that on Friday, April 3, they had received a notice from the Cyber Cell police of Surendranagar district, Gujarat. To serve the notice, a police team reached Ayush's house on April 4. But, Ayush's house was locked, after which the notice is being returned. The notice received from the Cyber Cell states that Ayush has carried out large-scale cyber fraud and hawala transactions through his Canara Bank account. After receiving the notice, the Cyber Cell had ordered him to appear within 15 days.

stories.title: Congress workers burn effigy of Assam chief minister in Meerut:UP chief Ajay Rai leads protests, demands apology for calling Kharge ‘Pagal’
stories.summary: Congress leaders protested in UP today and raised slogans against Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. Protesters termed Assam Chief Minister an ‘anti-Dalit’ CM. They allege CM insulted Mallikarjun Kharge, a leader from the Dalit community and the national president of the Congress party. In Meerut, Congress workers beat an effigy with slippers, then burnt it. They chanted slogans like 'Himanta Biswa Sarma Murdabad' (Down with Himanta Biswa Sarma). An effigy was burnt outside the Mathura Collectorate. In Ghaziabad, Congress leaders and workers tried to burn an effigy while protesting against the Assam Chief Minister, but the police snatched the effigy. This led to a scuffle between the workers and the police. Congress leaders allege that the police acted forcefully, even attempting to push workers down. Police had placed leaders under house arrest Before the Congress protest, the police had placed leaders under house arrest. In Varanasi, a large number of police forces arrived at the leaders' homes on Friday morning. Police are deployed outside the homes of several leaders, including the district and metropolitan presidents. UP Congress President Ajay Rai said- Sarma's use of words like Pagal (Mad) for Kharge is highly objectionable. This language shows his nervousness and frustration. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma should apologise to the entire nation. See 3 pictures- Why is the Assam CM facing opposition? The controversy began when Congress leader Pawan Khera accused the Chief Minister's wife, Riniki Bhuyan Sarma, of possessing foreign assets and multiple passports. Following this, the Assam Police raided Khera's residence in Delhi. Reacting to this action, Mallikarjun Kharge had criticised the government and called for clarification from the Ministry of External Affairs. Retaliating to this, Himanta Biswa Sarma used the word Pagal (Mad) for Kharge. Himanta said- Kharge ji is old, but he is still talking like a mad person. How can you make such accusations without knowing the truth? This is like killing someone and then talking about giving them medicine. He further added that Kharge should apologise to the country and the Assam Police would find Pawan Khera even from 'Pataal' (the underworld).

stories.title: Break on storms and rain in UP:Clear skies for 15 days; strong heat expected; mercury may cross 45 degrees, relief for farmers
stories.summary: The continuous spell of storms, rain, and hailstones in UP, ongoing for a week, is going to break from Friday. According to the Meteorological Department, the Western Disturbance is now weakening. This will lead to intense heat. The weather will remain clear for the next 15 days. There will be no rain. The mercury will jump by up to 10 °C, reaching above 45 °C. Hot winds will blow at a speed of 25 to 30 km/h. Farmers will get relief as the weather clears up. This is because the harvested wheat crops had gotten wet. The crops will dry quickly due to strong sunlight. This will enable farmers to thresh as soon as possible. The risk of crop grains turning black will be reduced. Earlier, in the last 48 hours, heavy rain accompanied by strong winds occurred in more than 50 districts. Lakhimpur Kheri recorded the highest rainfall of 15 mm. Bahraich received 6 mm, Kanpur 5.4 mm, and Lucknow 4.5 mm of rain. Jalaun was the hottest, with a temperature of 32 °C recorded. Meanwhile, Bijnor had the coldest night, where the mercury dropped to 11.5 °C. Atul Kumar Singh, a senior scientist at the Regional Meteorological Centre, Lucknow, stated- From today, the effect of the Western Disturbance will end. As a result, the weather will remain dry for the next 15 days. There is no possibility of rain anywhere. The temperature may increase by approximately 10 degrees. During the day, the effect of heat and strong sunlight will be felt again. Even at night, heat will be felt. Today's weather pictures- Know the condition of the cities- How will the weather be for the next 5 days? Also, take a look at yesterday's weather pictures- What was the reason for the sudden storm and rain? The sudden storm and rain were due to a Western Disturbance. This is normal for this season. Every year, this season brings rain with storms. However, this year Western Disturbances are arriving very frequently. Because of this, the weather has remained continuously stormy and rainy. Farmers suffered losses, wheat crop in crisis Untimely rains caused heavy losses to farmers. The wheat crop was destroyed. Regarding this, CM Yogi had instructed officials to go into the field. He said that officials should survey the damage within 24 hours and compensation should be given to the affected farmers as soon as possible. No kind of negligence will be tolerated. Providing help to farmers is the government's priority.
